blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This chapter explores how robotic systems and ambient intelligence can enhance care for older adults in residential aged care (RAC) homes and private homes. Although these settings differ, we frame both as extreme and challenging environments for human-robot interaction (HRI), characterised by cluttered and dynamic layouts, diverse resident needs, and limited on-site technical support. We review embodied and non-embodied systems that assist with daily living, safety monitoring, and social engagement, highlighting hybrid deployments where robots complement fixed and wearable sensors. To ensure these technologies are usable and effective, design considerations consider the cognitive, physical, and social needs of older adults. Interaction design prioritises accessibility for older adults with low digital literacy, using robust but simple voice interfaces, small sets of non-verbal cues, accessible screen-based companions, and safe object handovers. Privacy, trust, and acceptability are addressed via practical strategies such as on-device inference, data minimisation, visible consent controls, and transparent data handling aligned with emerging artificial intelligence (AI) and privacy regulation. Evaluation emphasises real-world metrics including false alarms per day, time to recover from faults, staff workload, and long-term system reliability. We close by outlining open research challenges and future directions for scalable, regulation-ready deployments that support aging with dignity, safety, and independence.
blocks.zh: 本章探讨了机器人系统和环境智能如何加强养老院和私人院对老年人的护理。 虽然这些环境不同,但我们将人与机器人互动作为极端和具有挑战性的环境,其特点是布局复杂和动态,居民需求多样,现场技术支持有限。 我们审查协助日常生活、安全监测和社会参与的成形和非健全的系统,强调机器人补充固定和可穿戴传感器的混合部署。 为了确保这些技术能够使用和有效,设计方面的考虑考虑到老年人的认知、身体和社会需要。 互动设计优先为数字文化水平低的老年人提供无障碍环境,使用强健但简单的语音界面,小套非语言提示,无障碍屏幕伴奏,安全对象交接. 隐私、信任和可接受性是通过实用战略加以解决的,例如根据新出现的人工智能和隐私条例进行推断、尽量减少数据、明显的同意控制以及透明的数据处理。 评价强调现实世界的衡量标准,包括每天的虚假警报、从过失中恢复的时间、工作人员的工作量和长期系统的可靠性。 最后,我们概述了开放的研究挑战和未来方向,以便进行可扩展的、准备就绪的部署,支持有尊严、安全和独立的老龄化。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Human–robot interaction (HRI) in residential aged care (RAC) and private homes is gaining importance as populations age, and more people seek to remain in familiar environments while receiving safe, respectful support ( WHO, 2021 ) . At the same time, care providers face mounting pressures from staffing shortages and rising costs, while families seek care solutions that are dependable, dignified, and easy to use ( Pu et al., 2019 ) . Robots and artificial intelligence (AI) systems offer promising assistance for everyday tasks, social engagement, and safety monitoring, with the overarching goal of enhancing quality of life while preserving autonomy ( Pu et al., 2019 ; De Graaf et al., 2019 ) .
However, these environments present unique challenges for HRI. Private homes are highly heterogeneous, cluttered, and subject to varying lighting conditions, while residents often have diverse physical, cognitive, and sensory needs. RAC homes add further complexity through shared spaces, rotating staff, and formal care routines that must integrate with existing workflows ( Carros et al., 2022 ; Cavallo et al., 2018 ; Coradeschi et al., 2013 ) . Taken together, these factors make HRI demanding, yet highly promising. We therefore consider RAC and private homes to be extreme HRI environments , characterised by high day-to-day variability, limited on-site technical support, and stringent expectations around safety, privacy, and usability.
Fig. 1 illustrates typical RAC corridors and private living rooms, highlighting clutter, mobility aids, and variable lighting that shape sensing and interaction demands.
blocks.zh:
随着人口的老化,居家老年护理(RAC)和私人家庭的人类-机器人互动(HRI)越来越重要,更多的人寻求留在熟悉的环境中,同时获得安全、尊重的支持(卫生组织,2021年)。 与此同时,护理提供者面临着工作人员短缺和费用上涨带来的越来越大的压力,而家庭则寻求可靠、有尊严和易于使用的护理解决方案(Pu等人,2019年)。 机器人和人工智能系统为日常任务、社会参与和安全监测提供了有希望的援助,其总体目标是提高生活质量,同时维护自主权(Pu等人,2019年;De Graaf等人,2019年)。
然而,这些环境对人权提出了独特的挑战。 私人住宅差异很大,杂乱无章,并受到不同照明条件的影响,而居民往往有不同的生理、认知和感官需求。 RAC之家通过共享空间,轮换工作人员,以及必须融入现有工作流程的正规护理常规(Carros等人,2022年;Cavallo等人,2018年;Coradeschi等人,2013年),增加了更多的复杂性。 这些因素加在一起,使得人权要求很高,但却很有希望。 因此,我们认为RAC和私人住宅是极端的HRI环境,其特点是日常变化很大,现场技术支持有限,以及对安全、隐私和可用性的严格期望。

blocks.en: In such a context, privacy and safety are not optional. They are fundamental design constraints that determine what can be sensed, stored, and shared in daily life. Clear consent controls, data minimisation, and transparent system behaviour help build trust and support long-term acceptance. Equally critical are robust operation, fault tolerance, graceful degradation, and reliable recovery mechanisms that protect dignity and reduce caregiver burden ( WHO, 2024 ; Jin et al., 2022 ) . These principles underpin the design and evaluation strategies explored throughout this chapter.
blocks.zh: 在这种情况下,隐私和安全不是可选的。 它们是基本的设计限制,决定了在日常生活中可以感知、储存和分享的东西。 明确的同意控制、数据最小化以及透明的系统行为有助于建立信任和支持长期接受。 同样重要的是强有力的运作、过错容忍、优雅的退化以及保护尊严和减轻照料者负担的可靠恢复机制(世卫组织,2024年;Jin等人,2022年)。 这些原则是整个本章所探讨的设计和评价战略的基础。

blocks.en: This chapter takes a primarily technical perspective on HRI to support older adults in both private and RAC homes. Our focus is on the sensors, perception algorithms, and robotic systems that enable safe and effective operation in these complex environments. While we acknowledge that human factors, usability, and organisational workflows are critical to success, the emphasis here is on the technical foundations that make these systems viable in practice, and we refer interested readers to complementary work on human factors, acceptability, co-design, and organisational implementation in care and home HRI ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Jones et al., 2025 ; Felber et al., 2024 ; Sumner et al., 2021 ; Backåberg et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 本章主要从技术角度看待人权,以支持私人和扶助家庭的老年人。 我们的重点是感应器、感知算法和机器人系统,这些系统能够在这些复杂环境中安全有效地运作。 虽然我们承认人的因素、可用性和组织工作流程对成功至关重要,但这里的重点是使这些系统在实践中可行的各项技术基础,我们请感兴趣的读者参考关于人的因素、可接受性、共同设计以及照料和家庭人权的组织实施的补充性工作(赵等人,2025年;琼斯等人,2025年;费尔伯等人,2024年;苏姆纳等人,2021年;Backåberg等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: We review robotic platforms, vision-based perception, and ambient sensing systems designed for domestic and care-home contexts, examining how these technologies interact with people and identifying scenarios where embodied systems—such as physical robots—are essential for delivering meaningful support. Our analysis centres on practical challenges that constrain deployment, including robust perception in cluttered, lived-in spaces; interaction design for older adults with low digital literacy; and seamless integration with smarthome and care infrastructure. Alongside these technical considerations, we address cross-cutting factors such as safety, privacy, and trust, which are indispensable for sustained acceptance and long-term reliability.
blocks.zh: 我们审查机器人平台、基于愿景的感知和环境感知系统,这些系统是为家庭和家庭环境设计的,审查这些技术如何与人互动,并确定那些包含的系统——如物理机器人——对于提供有意义的支持至关重要的情况。 我们的分析集中于制约部署的实际挑战,包括在拥挤的居住空间中强烈的感知;为数字文化水平低的老年人设计互动;以及与智能家庭和护理基础设施的无缝融合。 除了这些技术考虑之外,我们还处理安全、隐私和信任等交叉因素,这些因素对于持续接受和长期可靠性是必不可少的。

blocks.en: This chapter makes three main contributions. 1. It organises the design space for private and RAC homes into clear themes, including perception in lived-in spaces, interaction modalities tailored to diverse users, and deployment patterns that scale in practice. 2. It maps privacy and trust requirements to concrete design strategies, translating ethical and regulatory expectations into actionable choices such as on-device inference, minimal data flows, visible consent and mute controls, and transparent data handling aligned with emerging AI and privacy regulations. 3. It proposes practical evaluation considerations for real-world settings. These cover technical performance, safety, usability, and long-term reliability. Together, these contributions provide a roadmap for designing and evaluating robots and ambient intelligence systems that are usable, trustworthy, and regulation-ready, enabling older adults to age with dignity, safety, and independence.
blocks.zh: 本章作出三项主要贡献。 1. 它将私人和RAC住宅的设计空间组织成明确的主题,包括居住空间中的感知、适合不同用户的互动模式以及实际规模的部署模式。 2. 它将隐私和信任要求映射为具体设计战略,将道德和监管方面的期望转化为可采取行动的选择,如基于证据的推论、最低限度的数据流动、明显的同意和哑弹控制,以及符合新兴AI和隐私条例的透明数据处理。 3. 报告提出了现实世界环境的实际评价考虑。 其中包括技术性能、安全性、可用性和长期可靠性。 这些贡献共同提供了一个路线图,用于设计和评估可用、可信赖和可监管的机器人和环境情报系统,使老年人能够有尊严、安全和独立地老化。

blocks.en:
The remainder of this chapter is organised as follows. We begin by establishing the background, definitions, and constraints of residential aged care and private home environments, clarifying system types, care settings, stakeholder roles, and the unique challenges these spaces pose for HRI.
We then explore interaction modalities and integration , including voice interfaces, simple non-verbal cues, and accessible screen-based companions.
Next, we turn to technologies for perception and ambient sensing , covering people and scene understanding, sensor choices, and edge and cloud design patterns, with a focus on hybrid robot and sensor configurations.
This is followed by a discussion of privacy, trust, and acceptability , translating ethical expectations into practical design strategies such as on-device processing, visible controls, and transparent data handling.
We then address benchmarking and evaluation , moving beyond accuracy to real-world implementation, including safety events, usability, and long-term reliability.
Finally, we identify open research challenges , including robust multi-modal fusion, privacy-preserving learning, and safe manipulation and operation in confined and cluttered spaces.
We then outline future research directions, proposing reference architectures, evaluation standards, deployment playbooks, and pathways to regulation-ready evidence.
Fig. 2 summarises these themes and how they interconnect across the chapter.
blocks.zh:
本章其余部分的编排如下。 我们首先确定了养老院护理和私人家庭环境的背景、定义和制约因素,澄清了系统类型、护理环境、利益攸关方的作用以及这些空间对人权的独特挑战。
然后,我们探索互动模式和整合,包括语音界面、简单的非语言提示和基于屏幕的无障碍伴奏。
其次,我们转向感知技术和环境感知技术,涵盖人和场景理解,传感器选择,边缘和云设计模式,重点是混合机器人和传感器配置。
随后讨论了隐私、信任和可接受性问题,将道德期望转化为实际设计战略,如安装设备处理、明显的控制以及透明的数据处理。
然后我们讨论基准和评价问题,超越准确性,转向现实世界的执行,包括安全事件、可用性和长期可靠性。
最后,我们指出开放的研究挑战,包括强力的多模式融合、保护隐私的学习,以及在封闭和杂乱的空间中的安全操纵和操作。
然后,我们概述未来的研究方向,提出参考结构、评价标准、部署游戏本和可供监管的证据途径。

blocks.en: 2 Background, definitions, and constraints
blocks.zh: 2 背景、定义和制约因素

blocks.en: Before comparing specific technologies, it is essential to establish a shared understanding of the systems under discussion: what they are, where they operate, who interacts with them, and what successful deployment looks like. This section defines key system categories, situates them within RAC and private homes, clarifies stakeholder roles, and outlines the physical and human constraints that shape HRI in practice.
blocks.zh: 在比较具体技术之前,必须就正在讨论的系统达成共识:它们是什么、在哪里运作、谁与它们互动、部署成功是什么样子。 本节界定了关键的系统类别,将它们置于RAC和私人住宅中,澄清了利害关系方的作用,并概述了实际形成HRI的物质和人的限制。

blocks.en: 1 Settings and deployment context
blocks.zh: 1 设置和部署背景

blocks.en:
We consider two primary settings: residential aged care (RAC) homes and private homes (ageing-in-place), as summarised in Table 1 .
RAC homes offer structured environments with shared spaces, rotating staff, and formal procedures, enabling more managed deployments but requiring alignment with clinical governance, infection control, and the needs of multiple residents. In contrast, private homes are highly heterogeneous in layout, lighting, furnishings, and daily routines with minimal technical support and informal care arrangements.
blocks.zh:
我们考虑两个主要环境:养老院和私人院(就地养老院),见表1。
RAC之家提供结构化的环境,共用空间、工作人员轮换和正式程序,从而能够进行更多的管理部署,但需要与临床治理、感染控制以及多个居民的需求保持一致。 相比之下,私人住宅在布局、照明、家具和日常事务方面差异很大,技术支持和非正式照料安排极少。

blocks.en:
In both environments, tasks can be clinical, such as rehabilitation exercises or vital sign monitoring prompts; or non-clinical, including companionship, reminders, and safety checks. While clinical tasks require stricter documentation and oversight, non-clinical tasks are also essential for supporting well-being and daily routines.
These tasks must demonstrate clear benefits to users and carers, while systems must remain low effort to operate and maintain ( Zieni et al., 2025 ; Boudouraki et al., 2025 ; AlShamsi et al., 2022 ) . In addition, both settings impose stringent expectations around safety, privacy, and usability, making them extreme environments for HRI ( Carros et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
在这两种环境中,任务可以是临床的,如康复练习或重要标志监测提示;或者非临床的,包括陪伴,提醒,和安全检查. 虽然临床任务需要更严格的文献记录和监督,但非临床任务对于支持福利和日常工作也是必不可少的.
这些任务必须显示用户和照料者明显受益,而各系统在运作和维护方面必须保持低努力(Zieni等人,2025年;Boudouraki等人,2025年;Al Shamsi等人,2022年)。 此外,这两种环境都对安全、隐私和可用性提出了严格的期望,使其成为对人权的极端环境(Carros等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: 2 Robotic and ambient systems considered
blocks.zh: 2 所审议的机器人和环境系统

blocks.en: We adopt the nomenclature introduced in ( Silvera-Tawil, 2024 ) , and group assistive technologies into five categories. Socially-assistive robots (SARs) provide support primarily through social interaction rather than physical intervention. They aim to engage users emotionally and cognitively, offering companionship, therapeutic support, and motivation for tasks such as medication adherence, exercise, or learning. Assistive robots support individuals with physical disabilities in performing activities of daily living (ADLs), including mobility, personal hygiene, eating, and rehabilitation. This category includes robotic arms, smart wheelchairs, exoskeletons, and wearable devices that directly influence these movements and physical function. Teleoperated robots enable remote delivery of healthcare or support services. These systems are controlled by clinicians or carers at a distance and include telepresence platforms such as mobile video call devices that allow remote staff to navigate through a space and interact with residents. Service robots assist with logistical, repetitive, or physically demanding tasks such as delivering medications or disinfecting rooms. These robots typically have limited interactions with patients and pose minimal safety risks. Ambient intelligence systems , while not robots in a strict sense, include wearable and environmental sensors (e.g., cameras, microphones, radar, pressure mats) that monitor activities and detect risks in the background. In practice, these categories often overlap ( Cruces et al., 2024 ; Sandhu et al., 2024 ) . For example, a mobile robot may be paired with ambient sensors and a smart display to form an integrated system for reminders, safety monitoring, and family communication ( Yeo et al., 2023 ; Carros et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们采用(Silvera-Tawil,2024年)中引入的术语,并将辅助技术分为五类。 社会辅助机器人主要通过社会互动而不是物理干预提供支持。 它们旨在以情感和认知方式与用户接触,提供伴侣关系、治疗支助,以及诸如坚持药物、锻炼或学习等任务的动机。 辅助机器人支持身体残疾者从事日常生活活动,包括行动、个人卫生、饮食和康复。 这一类包括机器人臂,智能轮椅,外骨骼,以及直接影响这些运动和身体功能的可穿戴装置. 远程操作机器人能够远程提供医疗保健或支助服务。 这些系统由临床医生或护理人员远程控制,包括远程存在平台,如移动视频呼叫设备,使远程工作人员能够通过空间导航并与居民互动. 服务机器人协助完成后勤、重复或身体要求很高的任务,例如提供药品或消毒室。 这些机器人通常与患者的互动有限,安全风险最小. 环境智能系统虽然不是严格意义上的机器人,但包括可穿戴的和环境传感器(如相机,麦克风,雷达,压力垫),用于监控活动,检测背景中的风险. 在实践中,这些类别往往重叠(Cruces等人,2024年;Sandhu等人,2024年)。 例如,移动机器人可以配对环境传感器和智能显示器,形成提醒、安全监测和家庭通信的综合系统(Yeo等人,2023年;Carros等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: 3 Stakeholders and roles
blocks.zh: 3 利益攸关方和作用

blocks.en: HRI in these contexts involves multiple stakeholders with different priorities ( De Graaf et al., 2019 ; Sharkey and Sharkey, 2012 ; Boudouraki et al., 2025 ; Veling and Villing, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 在这些背景下,人权涉及多个具有不同优先事项的利益攸关方(De Graaf等人,2019年;Sharkey和Sharkey,2012年;Boudouraki等人,2025年;Veling和Villing,2024年)。

blocks.en: Older adults are usually the intended beneficiaries, but not always the primary interface users. In both settings, older adults may interact directly with socially assistive robots, voice interfaces, and screen-based companions, while ambient sensors such as wearables and environmental devices operate unobtrusively in the background. In care facilities, residents may engage with robots during activities or therapy, but many functions—such as alert dashboards or sensor data interpretation—are mediated through staff.
blocks.zh: 老年人通常是预期受益者,但并不总是主要的接口用户。 在两种场合中,老年人可以直接与社会辅助机器人,语音界面,以及基于屏幕的伴奏进行互动,而可穿戴和环境装置等环境传感器在背景中可以不受侵扰地运行. 在护理设施中,居民可以在活动或治疗期间与机器人接触,但许多功能——例如警报仪表板或传感器数据判读——是通过工作人员调解的。

blocks.en: Care staff and clinicians depend on these systems for actionable insights rather than raw data. Robots may deliver medication reminders or enable telepresence consultations, while ambient sensors provide fall alerts or routine monitoring. Integration with existing workflows is critical; alerts must be clear, reliable, and low-burden, and recovery from faults should not require technical expertise.
blocks.zh: 护理人员和临床医生依靠这些系统来获得可操作的见解,而不是原始数据。 机器人可以提供药物提醒或允许远程诊疗,而环境传感器则提供秋季警报或例行监测。 与现有工作流程的整合至关重要;警报必须明确、可靠和低负担,从断层中回收不需要技术专门知识。

blocks.en: Families and informal carers often manage setup and troubleshooting in private homes. They value systems that are easy to install, require minimal maintenance, and provide reassurance without compromising privacy. Hybrid deployments—combining robots for social engagement with ambient sensors for safety—must balance functionality with transparency and control.
blocks.zh: 家庭和非正规照料者往往在私人家中管理设置和解决问题。 它们珍视易于安装、需要最低限度维护、并在不损害隐私的情况下提供保证的系统。 混合部署——用于社会接触环境传感器的安全的混合机器人——必须兼顾功能与透明度和控制。

blocks.en: Finally, facility managers, vendors, and regulators shape deployment and governance. Managers prioritise reliability, infection control, and compliance. Vendors ensure interoperability, updates, and remote support. Regulators set privacy and safety baselines, influencing design choices such as on-device inference, visible sensing indicators, and consent mechanisms. Together, these roles underscore the need for technical solutions that align with human routines and regulatory obligations.
blocks.zh: 最后,设施管理人员、供应商和监管者决定了部署和治理。 管理人员优先考虑可靠性、感染控制和合规性。 供应商确保互操作性、更新和远程支持。 监管者设定了隐私和安全基线,影响设计选择,如探测推论、可见感知指标和同意机制。 这些作用加在一起突出表明,需要有符合人类常规和管理义务的技术解决办法。

blocks.en: Due to different priorities in these groups, their interests can conflict. Clinicians may request granular data to support monitoring, while residents may prefer strong limits on what is recorded and shared. Staff may value automation that saves time, while families may prioritise human contact. To make such trade-offs explicit, we explore in later sections a simple task, risk, and burden lens that weighs outcomes against cognitive load for users and staff, as well as data exposure needs ( Yeo et al., 2023 ; Carros et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 由于这些群体的优先事项不同,他们的利益可能发生冲突。 临床医生可能要求提供颗粒数据来支持监测,而居民则可能倾向于对记录和共享的有强烈限制. 工作人员可能重视可节省时间的自动化,而家庭则可以优先考虑人类接触。 为了明确这种权衡,我们在后面各节探讨一项简单的任务、风险和负担透镜,该透镜将结果与用户和工作人员认知负荷以及数据曝光需求加以权衡(Yeo等人,2023年;Carros等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: 4 Physical and environmental constraints
blocks.zh: 4 物质和环境制约因素

blocks.en:
Both private and RAC homes present significant physical challenges for HRI, but the nature of these challenges differs across settings. Private homes are highly individualised and dynamic. Lighting conditions shift throughout the day, and the presence of pets, mobility aids, and visitors introduces unpredictability. These environments can feature uneven flooring, steps, tight spaces, cluttered surfaces, and narrow corridors, all of which complicate robot navigation and sensing.
They can also be noisy, making speech recognition and sound-based alerts less reliable. Field studies consistently show that these everyday details shape how people use robots, often diverging from lab-based expectations ( Carros et al., 2022 ; Yeo et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
私人住宅和RAC住宅对人权提出了重大的实际挑战,但这些挑战的性质因环境而异。 私人住宅具有高度个性化和活力。 照明条件全天变换,宠物,行动辅助器和访客的存在带来了不可预测性. 这些环境可以以不均匀的地板,台阶,紧凑的空间,杂乱的表面,以及狭窄的走廊为特征,所有这些都使机器人的导航和感知变得复杂.
它们也可能是吵闹的,使得语音识别和基于声音的警报不那么可靠. 实地研究一致表明,这些日常细节决定了人们如何使用机器人,往往与实验室的期望不同(Carros等人,2022年;Yeo等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: RAC homes, while more standardised, involve shared spaces, equipment, infection control protocols, and frequent furniture changes. Robots and sensors must feature wipe-down surfaces, docking stations, and cable management solutions that do not obstruct movement or create new hazards ( Castelli et al., 2022 ; Australian Commission on Safety and Quality in Health Care, 2024 ) . Robots must cope with narrow corridors, occlusions, and strong lighting variations, while maintaining compliance with safety and hygiene requirements. Although care homes may offer more predictable layouts, they still involve frequent changes: assistive equipment is moved, chairs and tables are repositioned, and staff workflows vary across shifts. Pathways must also remain compliant with evacuation and manual handling requirements, which limit where larger mobile platforms can wait, turn, or dock between tasks.
blocks.zh: RAC住宅虽然更加标准化,但涉及共享空间,设备,感染控制协议,以及频繁的家具更换. 机器人和传感器必须具备擦拭表面、对接站和不阻碍移动或造成新危险的电缆管理解决方案(Castelli等人,2022年;澳大利亚保健安全和质量委员会,2024年)。 机器人必须应对狭窄的走廊、隔离和强烈的照明变化,同时遵守安全和卫生要求。 尽管护理院可能提供更可预测的布局,但它们仍然涉及频繁的变化:辅助设备被移动,椅子和桌子被重新定位,工作人员的工作流程因班次而异。 路径还必须始终遵守疏散和人工操作要求,这些要求限制了较大的移动平台在任务之间等待、转弯或对接的情况。

blocks.en: Across both settings, robust perception, adaptive mapping, and conservative motion planning are essential. Sensor fusion, combining radar, vision, and audio, is often necessary to maintain reliability ( Yeo et al., 2023 ; Piaggio et al., 2023 ) . Ultimately, successful HRI relies on systems that are resilient to physical variability, respectful of user routines, and compatible with the practical realities of home and facility care.
blocks.zh: 在这两种情况下,强有力的认知、适应性绘图和保守的运动规划都至关重要。 传感器聚变,结合雷达,视觉,音频,对于保持可靠性往往是必要的(Yeo等人,2023年;Piaggio等人,2023年). 最终,成功的HRI依赖于能够抵御物理变化的系统,尊重用户的常规,并符合家庭和设施护理的实际现实。

blocks.en: 5 Human factors
blocks.zh: 5. 人的因素

blocks.en: Older adults often face barriers such as limited digital literacy, sensory impairment (e.g., hearing or vision), and varying degrees of cognitive decline. In private homes, these challenges are compounded by the absence of on-site technical support ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Therefore, systems must be intuitive, require minimal setup, and degrade gracefully under faults. Interaction should favour simple, repeatable cues over complex dialogues, and sensing behaviour must be transparent to maintain trust. Staff need predictable alerts that do not add cognitive load or disrupt workflows, or systems risk being disabled despite technical capability.
blocks.zh: 老年人往往面临一些障碍,例如数字知识有限、感官障碍(例如听力或视力)以及认知下降程度不同。 在私人家庭中,由于缺乏现场技术支持,这些挑战更为严重(赵等人,2025年)。 因此,系统必须是直观的,需要最小的设置,并在缺陷下优雅地降解. 互动应有利于简单、可重复的提示,而不是复杂的对话,而感官行为必须透明,以维持信任。 工作人员需要可预测的警报,这种警报不会增加认知负载或扰乱工作流程,或者系统尽管有技术能力,仍有可能瘫痪。

blocks.en: These conditions have direct design implications for HRI: • Perception must adapt to real lived-in spaces, supporting robust tracking with partial views, variable lighting, and coping with tight, cluttered spaces. • Interaction should prioritise simplicity and consistency. Short prompts, large font sizes, and clear confirmation phrases often work better than complex dialogue structures. • Cognitive and sensory load must be managed by limiting unnecessary prompts and notifications, ensuring that alerts are meaningful and actionable. • Workflows should degrade gracefully. If network connectivity is lost, core local functions should continue to operate, and the system should clearly flag which services are delayed or unavailable. • Privacy should be a default, with blurred or abstracted views when high detail is unnecessary, summaries stored instead of raw data, and visible indicators showing what is sensed and who can access the data ( Carros et al., 2022 ) . • Personalisation should be transparent and reversible, for example, allowing adjustments such as approach distance or prompt timing while providing clear controls to reset, pause, or review adaptations ( Papadopoulos et al., 2020 ; Yeo et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 这些条件对HRI有直接的设计影响: 认识必须适应真实的居住空间,支持用部分视图、可变照明和应对紧凑,杂乱的空间来进行有力的跟踪. • 互动应优先考虑简洁和一致性。 短提示,大字体大小,和清晰的确认短语往往比复杂的对话结构更有效. • 必须通过限制不必要的提示和通知来管理认知和感官负荷,确保警报是有意义的和可操作的。 • 工作流量应大大降低。 如果失去网络连通性,地方核心功能应继续运行,系统应明确标明哪些服务被延迟或无法提供. • 隐私应当是默认的,当高细节没有必要时,会模糊或抽象地表达观点,储存摘要而不是原始数据,并显示什么是感知的,谁可以获取数据(Carros等人,2022年)的可见指标。 个性化应当透明和可逆转,例如,允许调整,如接近距离或即时时间,同时提供明确的控制以重新设置、暂停或审查适应性(Papapourus等人,2020年;Yeo等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Perception must adapt to real lived-in spaces, supporting robust tracking with partial views, variable lighting, and coping with tight, cluttered spaces.
blocks.zh: 感知必须适应真实的居住空间,支持用局部视图,可变照明进行强力跟踪,并应对紧凑,杂乱的空间.

blocks.en: Interaction should prioritise simplicity and consistency. Short prompts, large font sizes, and clear confirmation phrases often work better than complex dialogue structures.
blocks.zh: 互动应优先考虑简洁和一致性。 短提示,大字体大小,和清晰的确认短语往往比复杂的对话结构更有效.

blocks.en: Cognitive and sensory load must be managed by limiting unnecessary prompts and notifications, ensuring that alerts are meaningful and actionable.
blocks.zh: 必须通过限制不必要的提示和通知来管理认知和感官负荷,确保警报是有意义的和可操作的。

blocks.en: Workflows should degrade gracefully. If network connectivity is lost, core local functions should continue to operate, and the system should clearly flag which services are delayed or unavailable.
blocks.zh: 工作流量应优雅地降低。 如果失去网络连通性,地方核心功能应继续运行,系统应明确标明哪些服务被延迟或无法提供.

blocks.en: Privacy should be a default, with blurred or abstracted views when high detail is unnecessary, summaries stored instead of raw data, and visible indicators showing what is sensed and who can access the data ( Carros et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 隐私应该是默认的,当高细节没有必要时,会模糊或抽象地表达观点,存储摘要而不是原始数据,以及显示感知内容和谁能访问数据的可见指标(Carros等人,2022年).

blocks.en: Personalisation should be transparent and reversible, for example, allowing adjustments such as approach distance or prompt timing while providing clear controls to reset, pause, or review adaptations ( Papadopoulos et al., 2020 ; Yeo et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 例如,个性化应当透明和可逆转,允许调整,如接近距离或及时时间安排,同时提供明确的控制以重新设定、暂停或审查适应性(Papapos等人,2020年;Yeo等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: In RAC homes, configuration and logging tools should align with existing roles and documentation practices so care workers can understand and adjust behaviour without specialist support. In private homes, setup and control should be simple enough for older people, family carers, and installers to manage with minimal ongoing effort. These principles align with universal design and accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.2 ( World Wide Web Consortium (W3C), 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 在RAC家庭,配置和伐木工具应当与现有的作用和文件编制做法保持一致,以便护理人员能够在没有专家支持的情况下理解和调整行为。 在私人家庭中,设置和控制应足够简单,使老年人、家庭照料者和安装者能够以最小的持续努力进行管理。 这些原则符合通用设计和无障碍标准,例如WCAG 2.2(W3C),2023。

blocks.en: 6 Ethical, legal, and cultural considerations
blocks.zh: 6. 道德、法律和文化考虑

blocks.en: Designing HRI for residential aged care and private homes is not only a technical challenge but also an ethical and regulatory one. Systems must comply with privacy, safety, and accessibility standards while operating in highly personal environments. Principles such as data minimisation, transparency, and informed consent are foundational, ensuring that sensing and decision-making respect user autonomy. These principles extend beyond interface design to system architecture, influencing choices such as on-device inference, short retention periods, and clear indicators of active sensing. Recent guidance for AI-enabled technology in health and disability settings expands on practical principles that align with HRI in care contexts ( WHO, 2024 ; Silvera-Tawil et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 为养老院和私人住宅设计人权不仅是一项技术挑战,也是一项道德和管理挑战。 在高度个人环境下运行时,系统必须符合隐私、安全和无障碍标准。 诸如数据最小化、透明度和知情同意等原则是基本原则,确保感知和决策尊重用户自主权。 这些原则超越了接口设计,扩展到系统架构,影响诸如on-device推断,短保留期,以及主动感知的明确指标等选择. 最近对卫生和残疾环境中人工智能技术的指导扩展了与护理环境中的人权相一致的实际原则(世卫组织,2024年;Silvera-Tawil等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Compliance with emerging AI governance frameworks is increasingly critical. Regulatory and standards baselines are converging on risk-based governance. Teams can draw on the EU AI Act for duties applied to higher-risk systems, such as transparency, human oversight, post-market monitoring, and on ISO and IEC guidance, such as ISO and IEC 23894:2023 for risk management through the lifecycle of AI systems ( European Parliament and the Council of the European Union, 2024 ; International Organization for Standardization and International Electrotechnical Commission, 2023 ) . In Australia, the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner’s Australian Privacy Principles sets duties on collection, consent, access, and security, including for audio and video from homes; and offers practical guidance for informed consent, retention limits, and access logs ( Office of the Australian Information Commissioner, 2022 ) . Residential care homes may also trigger additional obligations under health, aged care, or medical device regulations, whereas in private homes, many deployments are currently framed as consumer or lifestyle technologies even when they influence care, which creates a grey zone that designers should treat cautiously.
blocks.zh: 遵守正在出现的AI治理框架越来越重要。 监管和标准基线与基于风险的治理正在趋同。 团队可以借鉴欧盟AI法,承担适用于高风险系统的职责,如透明度,人的监督,市场后监测,以及ISO和IEC指南,如ISO和IEC 23894:2023,通过AI系统生命周期进行风险管理(欧洲议会和欧洲联盟理事会,2024年;国际标准化组织和国际电工委员会,2023年). 在澳大利亚,澳大利亚信息专员办公室的《澳大利亚隐私原则》规定了收集、同意、获取和安全的义务,包括从家中获取音频和视频的义务;并为知情同意、保留限制和访问日志提供实际指导(澳大利亚信息专员办公室,2022年)。 住宅护理院也可能引发卫生、老年护理或医疗器械条例规定的额外义务,而在私人住宅中,即使影响护理,许多部署目前也被视为消费或生活方式技术,这就形成了一个灰色地带,设计者应当谨慎对待。

blocks.en: Beyond legal compliance, cultural competence and fairness are essential for inclusivity. Homes are personal spaces. People differ in language, routines, family roles, and how they read touch, direct their gaze, and the distance at which they interact with others. Trials of culturally competent social robots show that adapting greetings, topics, and forms of address can improve comfort and engagement, but only when changes are transparent and not deceptive ( Papadopoulos et al., 2020 ) . Over-personalisation, particularly if it is perceived as manipulative or uncanny, can reduce trust and acceptance rather than improve it.
blocks.zh: 除了遵守法律外,文化能力和公平对于包容性至关重要。 家庭是个人空间。 人们在语言,常规,家庭角色,以及如何阅读触觉,引导视线,以及他们与他人互动的距离上都有所不同. 对具有文化能力的社会机器人的试验表明,调整问候、专题和地址形式可以改善舒适和接触,但只有在变革是透明的而不是欺骗性的(Papapows等人,2020年)。 过于个性化,特别是如果被认为具有操纵性或不可想象性,会减少信任和接受,而不是改善信任和接受。

blocks.en: 3 Interaction modalities and integration
blocks.zh: 3. 互动模式和一体化

blocks.en:
In this section, we focus on how factors such as cluttered layouts, variable lighting, and the residents’ diverse sensory and cognitive abilities shape interaction design for robots in RAC and private home care. We examine verbal and non-verbal modalities, fallback mechanisms, and integration patterns that aim to ensure reliability and accessibility in real-world conditions.
Fig. 3 illustrates a typical interaction scenario in a residential aged care lounge, with a social robot embedded within a wider ambient sensing infrastructure and operating under these real-world constraints.
blocks.zh:
在这一节中,我们关注诸如杂乱布局、可变照明、居民的多种感官和认知能力等因素如何塑造RAC和私人家庭护理中的机器人的互动设计。 我们审查口头和非口头方式、倒退机制以及旨在确保在现实世界条件下的可靠性和无障碍性的一体化模式。
图3显示了一个居家老年护理休息室的典型互动情景,一个社会机器人嵌入了更广泛的环境感知基础设施,并在这些现实世界的限制下运作。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Example interaction scenario in a residential aged care lounge, showing a mobile social robot engaging an older adult via speech and on-screen prompts, alongside ambient devices such as a smart speaker, wall-mounted tablet, television, and ceiling and wall sensors. The scene illustrates how multimodal interaction, distributed sensing, clutter, mobility aids, and uneven lighting jointly shape design choices.
blocks.zh: 图3:一个居家老年护理休息室的示例互动情景,显示一个移动社会机器人通过演讲和屏幕上提示,与诸如智能扬声器、挂墙平板、电视、天花板和墙壁传感器等环境设备一起,让一个老年人参与其中。 该场景说明了多模式互动、分布式感知、杂乱无章、助行器和不均匀照明如何共同设计。

blocks.en: 1 Interaction with robotic systems
blocks.zh: 1 与机器人系统的互动

blocks.en: Verbal interaction
blocks.zh: 口头互动

blocks.en:
Verbal interfaces offer an intuitive way for older adults to interact with digital systems, particularly when hands are occupied or mobility is limited. However, these interfaces must be designed for the realities of home and RAC environments, where background noise, overlapping conversations, and age-related changes in speech are common. Far-field microphones often struggle with television or radio crosstalk, and multi-party dialogue can further degrade recognition accuracy.
Large multilingual models trained on diverse data (e.g., Whisper and SeamlessM4T v2) have improved robustness to noise and support accented or code-mixed speech ( Radford et al., 2023 ; Barrault et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
口头界面为老年人提供了与数字系统互动的直观方式,特别是在手被占用或行动能力有限的情况下。 然而,这些界面必须针对家庭环境和RAC环境的现实来设计,在这种环境中,背景噪声,重叠的对话,以及与年龄有关的语音变化是常见的. 远野麦克风经常与电视或广播交叉交谈而挣扎,多党对话会进一步降低识别准确性.
接受过多种数据培训的大型多语种模型(如Whisper和SeamlessM4T v2)提高了对噪声的强性,并支持重音或密码混合的语音(Radford等人,2023年;Barrault等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Despite these advances, recent benchmarks show that Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems continue to underperform with older adult speech in noisy home settings, especially when speech is monotone or hesitant ( Escolano et al., 2024 ) . Field studies confirm these limitations, reporting lower accuracy rates and occasional delays. To mitigate these risks, designs should incorporate confirmation steps for safety-critical actions, provide fallback options such as a tablet, and favour short unambiguous utterances such as yes, no, or stop ( Cao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Yeo et al., 2023 ) . Reliability improves when systems combine on-device voice-activity detection with basic beamforming. Providing an optional press-to-talk or hold-to-listen mode for critical intents, and applying diarisation and barge-in suppression for robots to ignore irrelevant audio sources, further enhances performance ( Radford et al., 2023 ; Barrault et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但最近的基准表明,自动语音识别系统在吵闹的家庭环境中,尤其是当语音是单调或犹豫时,对年长的成年人的语音仍然表现不佳(Escolano等人,2024年)。 实地研究证实了这些局限性,报告准确率较低,偶尔出现延误。 为了减轻这些风险,设计应纳入安全关键行动的确认步骤,提供诸如平板电脑等倒置选项,并赞成 " 是 " 、 " 不 " 或 " 停止 " 等简短的明确表述(Cao等人,2024年;Wang等人,2023年;Yeo等人,2023年)。 当系统结合了在线语音活性检测和基本束成型时,可靠性得到改善. 为关键意图提供可选的对讲或对听模式,对机器人应用对称和驳船压制以忽略无关的音频源,进一步提高性能(Radford等人,2023年;Barrault等人,2023年).

blocks.en:
Interfaces should make microphone states visible (e.g., listening or muted), request explicit confirmations for irreversible actions such as calling an ambulance, and, where possible, perform on-device ASR while transmitting only transcripts or event summaries.
Accessibility defaults remain essential, including large targets, high-contrast captions, and clear error messages ( World Wide Web Consortium (W3C), 2023 ) .
Interfaces should announce state changes (e.g., microphone muted or unmuted) for users with low vision. Finally, every interaction flow should include an error recovery ladder to maintain usability under failure conditions: Plan B, a fallback to a screen prompt, and Plan R, a retry step before escalation to human support.
blocks.zh:
接口应使麦克风状态(如听觉或哑音)明显可见,要求明确确认不可逆的行动,如呼叫救护车,并在可能时,在只传送记录誊本或事件摘要的同时进行ASR。
无障碍默认仍然至关重要,包括大目标、高调字幕和清晰错误信息 (万维网联合会(W3C),2023).
界面应当为视力低的用户宣布状态变化(如麦克风变音或未变音). 最后,每一次交互流都应包括一个故障回收阶梯,以便在故障条件下保持可用性: B计划,倒向屏幕提示器,R计划,在人类支持升级前的重试步骤.

blocks.en: Non-verbal interaction
blocks.zh: 非语言互动

blocks.en: Non-verbal cues, such as gestures, gaze, and posture, play an important role in making robots intuitive and socially acceptable. These modalities complement speech and provide alternative channels of communication for users with hearing impairments or limited verbal ability. However, their design must account for the sensory and cognitive diversity of older adults and the physical constraints of cluttered environments, as subtle cues can be missed ( Morillo-Mendez et al., 2023 ; Morillo-Mendez et al., 2024 ; Urakami and Seaborn, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 非口头提示,如手势、目光和姿态,在使机器人直观和社会接受方面发挥重要作用。 这些方式补充了语音,并为听力障碍或语言能力有限的用户提供了替代的交流渠道. 然而,他们的设计必须考虑到老年人的感官和认知多样性以及杂乱的环境的物理限制,因为微妙的提示是可以忽略的(Morillo-Mendez等人,2023年;Morillo-Mendez等人,2024年;Urakami和Seaborn,2023年)。

blocks.en: Effective HRI in care settings favours a small and consistent, for example, point, wave, and open-hand stop, with slow, exaggerated motion profiles that remain legible under glare, clutter, and low light. Eye gaze and head orientation can support turn-taking and guidance, but should be complemented by redundant channels such as expressive lighting bands and large on-screen icons. These backups become primary when gesture confidence drops due to occlusion or poor lighting, with verbal confirmation where needed.
blocks.zh: 护理环境的有效HRI有利于小而一致的,例如点、波和开关,在光线下缓慢、夸张的动作图谱仍然清晰可见。 眼睛凝视和头部定向可以支持转动和引导,但应该辅以多余的通道,如表现灯带和大屏幕图标. 这些备份在由于隔离或照明不良导致手势自信下降时成为首要的,必要时可口头确认.

blocks.en: Physical interaction requires additional safeguards. Approach distance should be personalised rather than fixed, and interactions should remain natural to support engagement. For physical contact, such as handovers, robots could announce their intent verbally (e.g., "I’m passing the cup") and implement retreat behaviours when unexpected contact is detected ( Duan et al., 2024 ) . It is important to keep interactions natural to improve engagement and enjoyment.
blocks.zh: 物理互动需要额外的保障。 方法距离应该个性化而不是固定,互动应该保持自然,以支持接触。 对于身体接触,如移交,机器人可以口头宣布其意图(如"我正在通过杯子"),并在发现意外接触时实施退缩行为(Duan等人,2024年). 必须保持自然互动,以改善接触和享受。

blocks.en: In cluttered rooms, gesture recognition should rely on short temporal consistency (around one second of a stable pose) and conservative confidence thresholds to avoid false positives. When gestures fail, expressive lighting and on-screen prompts should remain legible for users with low vision or higher cognitive load ( Urakami and Seaborn, 2023 ; Morillo-Mendez et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 在杂乱的房间里,手势识别应依靠短暂的时间一致性(约1秒钟的稳定姿势)和保守的信心阈值,以避免虚假的阳性. 当手势失败时,对于视力低或认知负载更高的用户,表达灯光和屏幕上提示仍应可辨认(Urakami and Seaborn, 2023; Morillo-Mendez等人, 2024 ).

blocks.en: Cultural factors also influence non-verbal interaction. Cross-cultural studies show that gesture preferences vary between cultures, especially for greetings and abstract commands ( Shen and Johal, 2025 ) . For hygiene and safety, robots should use smooth, wipeable covers. Charging and docking stations should be placed away from spill zones, and from paths used by walking aids to reduce incidents ( Australian Commission on Safety and Quality in Health Care, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 文化因素也影响非语言互动. 跨文化研究显示,各种文化对手势的偏好各不相同,特别是对问候和抽象指令而言(Shen and Johal, 2025). 为了卫生和安全起见,机器人应当使用光滑,可擦拭的盖子. 充电站和停靠站应当远离溢出区和步行辅助器具使用的道路以减少事故(澳大利亚保健安全和质量委员会,2024年)。

blocks.en: 2 Integration with the home and care ecosystem
blocks.zh: 2. 与家庭和护理生态系统的结合

blocks.en: Figure 4 : System architecture: robot and ambient sensors feed a local hub for edge processing and policy enforcement, while clinical summaries flow to cloud/Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems via standard interfaces built on Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR).
blocks.zh: 图4:系统架构:机器人和环境传感器为边缘处理和政策执行提供当地枢纽,而临床摘要则通过建立在快速保健互操作性资源(FHIR)上的标准接口流入云/电子健康记录系统。

blocks.en: Integration in home and care environments must address multi-actor workflows and limited on-site technical support. Systems should minimise setup burden and align with existing clinical and care data pathways to avoid creating isolated technology silos. Robots rarely operate alone; they function as part of a broader ecosystem that includes ambient sensors, local hubs, and cloud services. Fig. 4 illustrates this architecture, where robots interact with IoT devices and clinical systems to enable edge processing, enforce privacy policies, and support data exchange.
blocks.zh: 融入家庭和照料环境必须解决多行为者的工作流程和有限的现场技术支持。 系统应尽量减少设置负担,并与现有的临床和护理数据路径保持一致,以避免形成孤立的技术筒仓。 机器人很少单独运作;机器人作为包括环境传感器、地方枢纽和云服务在内的更广泛生态系统的一部分发挥作用。 图4说明了这种架构,机器人与IOT设备和临床系统互动,使边缘处理成为可能,执行隐私政策,并支持数据交换.

blocks.en: Smart-home and IoT sensors, such as radar, wearables, and door or bed sensors, provide valuable context signals, including occupancy, routines, and sleep patterns. Robots can consume these signals while acting as mobile sensors and actuators, bridging gaps between fixed infrastructure and dynamic user needs. This hybrid approach improves robustness and enables richer interaction, for example, by combining fall detection from ambient sensors with verbal prompts or physical assistance from a robot.
blocks.zh: 智能家庭感应器和IOT感应器,如雷达,可穿戴感应器,以及门或床感应器,提供了有价值的上下文信号,包括占用,常规,睡眠模式. 机器人可以在充当移动传感器和起动器的同时消耗这些信号,弥合固定基础设施和动态用户需求之间的差距. 这种混合方法提高了稳健性,使互动更加丰富,例如,将环境传感器的秋季探测与机器人的口头提示或物理协助相结合。

blocks.en:
When clinical data must flow (e.g., fall alerts or adherence summaries to a clinician), standards-based integration is essential. Interfaces built on Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) ensure events are recorded in existing electronic health record systems rather than bespoke pipelines ( Pavão et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024a ) . A practical pattern is to publish minimal event payloads (e.g., an Observation or Detected Issue with timestamp, severity, and a short rationale), maintain an audit log of “who saw what and when”, and default to edge processing with only upstream summaries. Raw audio or video should be shared only under explicit consent and with clear retention limits, as elaborated in Section 5 .
Edge AI enables real-time decision-making but operates under constraints of compute, memory, and battery life ( Tahir and Parasuraman, 2025 ) . Early deployments benefit from limiting the integration surface to a small set of well-defined events (e.g., possible fall, missed medication prompt, and failed dock), each with severity levels and human-readable rationales. This reduces maintenance and accelerates clinical sign-off. Aligning with national interoperability plans (e.g., Australia’s, 2023 to 2028 roadmap) and provider incentives for remote monitoring will further reduce deployment friction and support scalable adoption ( Australian Digital Health Agency, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
当临床数据必须流动时(例如,向临床医生发出坠落警报或坚持摘要),基于标准的整合至关重要。 在快速保健互操作性资源(FHIR)基础上建立的接口确保事件记录在现有的电子保健记录系统中,而不是在旁听管道中(Pavão等人,2023年;Li等人,2024a年)。 一种实际模式是公布最小事件有效载荷(例如,有时间戳、严重程度和简短理由的观测或检测问题)、保持“谁看到什么和何时看到”的审计记录,并默认仅用上游摘要进行处理。 如第5节所述,只有经明确同意和有明确保留限制的情况下,才能分享原始音频或视频。
Edge AI允许实时决策,但在计算、记忆和电池寿命的限制下运作(Tahir和Parasuraman,2025年)。 早期的部署得益于将整合表面限制在一小组定义明确的事件(如可能坠落,误用药物即时,以及故障的码头),每个事件都具有严重程度和人可读的理由. 这减少了维护,加速了临床签注. 与国家互操作性计划(如澳大利亚的2023至2028年路线图)和提供方的远程监测激励措施保持一致,将进一步减少部署摩擦并支持可扩展的采用(澳大利亚数字卫生局,2024年)。

blocks.en: 3 Design patterns and deployment insights
blocks.zh: 3 设计模式和部署见解

blocks.en: Mobile social robots in RAC homes.
blocks.zh: RAC家中的移动社交机器人.

blocks.en: Deployments of social robots such as Pepper (in a UK RAC home) highlight the importance of reliability and ease of customisation over feature breadth ( Manavi et al., 2025 ) . In a three-month in-situ study, Pepper was used regularly, around 1 h/day, mostly in one-to-one sessions. Staff success depended on how easily they could tailor activities and routines, with reliability and time pressure acting as barriers. Follow-up work showed that providing care professionals with a lightweight mobile application to configure content and behaviours across multiple facilities increased appropriation and reduced reliance on technical staff ( Manavi et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 部署Pepper(在英国RAC之家)等社会机器人,凸显了可靠性和自定义在地物宽度上容易度的重要性(Manavi等人,2025年)。 在为期三个月的现场研究中,佩珀被定期使用,大约为1小时/日,多为一对一课. 工作人员的成功取决于他们如何容易调整活动和例行工作,而可靠性和时间压力则成为障碍。 后续工作表明,向护理专业人员提供轻量级移动应用程序,以配置多个设施的内容和行为,增加了拨款,减少了对技术人员的依赖(Manavi等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Telepresence for connection and clinical touchpoints.
blocks.zh: 连接和临床触点的电传.

blocks.en: Telepresence robots are valued for maintaining social contact and enabling remote clinical interactions, provided navigation is smooth and controls remain simple ( Yeo et al., 2023 ) . A 2024 qualitative study with frontline staff in hospitals and long-term care homes emphasised workflow fit, training, and clear escalation procedures as requirements for routine use in dementia care ( Ren et al., 2024 ) . Smaller trials indicate that repeated exposure improves comfort and perceived usefulness, although in-person contact remains important ( Arthanat et al., 2024 ) . In practice, pairing autonomous navigation with scheduled sessions and a short menu of common tasks (e.g., check-in, family call, and medication prompt) reduces cognitive load for staff and residents.
blocks.zh: 远程机器人在保持社会接触和远程临床互动方面受到重视,只要导航顺利,控制仍然简单(Yeo等人,2023年)。 对医院和长期护理院一线工作人员进行的2024年定性研究强调工作流程适合、培训和明确的升级程序,以此作为痴呆症护理常规使用的要求(Ren等人,2024年)。 规模较小的试验表明,反复接触会改善舒适感和被认为有用,尽管当面接触仍然很重要(Arthanat等人,2024年)。 在实践中,将自主导航与预定的会话和短菜单的常见任务(如登机、家庭电话和药品即时)配对,可减少工作人员和居民的认知负荷。

blocks.en: Companion/therapeutic robots.
blocks.zh: 伴奏/治疗机器人.

blocks.en: Meta-analytic evidence suggests that PARO, the robotic seal, can reduce agitation and improve mood in dementia care when sessions are structured and integrated into activity schedules rather than left as ad-hoc interactions ( Rashid et al., 2023 ) . Recent clinical studies confirm sustained benefits for neuropsychiatric and social outcomes when programs are maintained and staff are trained ( Nam and Park, 2025 ; Che et al., 2025 ) . These findings underscore that companion devices should be treated as part of a program with a defined dose and frequency and facilitator training, rather than simply being a device left in a common room.
blocks.zh: Meta-analysis分析证据表明,机器人封印PARO可以减少痴呆症护理中的焦虑,改善情绪,因为会议是安排和纳入活动时间表的,而不是作为临时互动留下(Rashid等人,2023年)。 最近的临床研究证实,在维持方案和培训工作人员时,神经精神病学和社会结果将持续受益(Nam and Park,2025年;Che等人,2025年)。 这些调查结果强调,配套装置应作为具有确定剂量和频率以及促进者训练的程序的一部分处理,而不是仅仅作为留在共同房间的装置。

blocks.en: Home-focused social companions.
blocks.zh: 以家庭为重点的社会伴侣.

blocks.en: Deployments of ElliQ report reductions in loneliness and improved daily engagement when the device is proactive, uses short, forgiving dialogues, and hands off to phone or video channels when needed. Published design notes emphasise clear boundaries, avoiding overly human-like presentation, and multi-modal prompts, combining voice and visual cues, to support diverse users ( Broadbent et al., 2024 ) . Studies show that anthropomorphic cues can both increase trust and trigger discomfort depending on context and user expectations ( Chen, 2025 ) . Systems should therefore be proactive but bounded, announcing intentions, offering opt-outs, and handing over to human channels when system confidence is low.
blocks.zh: ElliQ的部署报告,在设备积极主动时,孤独感减少,日常接触得到改善,使用了简短的、宽容的对话,并在需要时不接触电话或视频频道。 出版的设计说明强调明确的界限,避免过于人性化的呈现,以及多种模式的提示,结合语音和视觉提示,支持不同的用户(Broadbent等人,2024年). 研究显示,人类形态提示既会增加信任,又会引发不适,这取决于上下文和用户的期望(Chen, 2025). 因此,各系统应积极主动,但有限度,宣布意图,提出选择退出,并在系统信心低时移交给人类渠道。

blocks.en: Telepresence platforms in aged care (e.g., temi robots).
blocks.zh: 老年护理(如泰米机器人)中的远程生存平台.

blocks.en: Early implementation and Quality Improvement (QI) reports from long-term care show resident interest in self-navigating telepresence for activities and check-ins, provided sessions are scheduled and content is staff-curated. The key technical needs are robust voice control, vital-sign connectors, and Electronic Health Record (EHR) integration ( Weigand et al., 2022 ) . A pragmatic starting point is a minimal clinical payload that includes device vitals and brief encounter notes, easing adoption while building toward deeper integration.
blocks.zh: 长期护理的早期实施和质量改进报告表明,居民有兴趣自行导航活动和报到的电话,但需安排会议,内容由工作人员确定。 关键技术需要是强有力的语音控制、生命号连接器和电子健康记录集成(Weigand等人,2022年)。 一个务实的起点是最小的临床有效载荷,包括装置生命体和短暂的接触记录,在逐步深化一体化的同时放松采用。

blocks.en: Section 6 revisits these interaction patterns and evaluates their real-world performance, using metrics such as dock success rate, false activations in speech, false alarms per day, and time to recover after faults, alongside usability and workload scores.
blocks.zh: 第6节重新审视这些互动模式,评价其真实世界的性能,使用诸如码头成功率、语音中的假激活、每天的假警报、断层后恢复的时间,以及可用性和工作量的分数。

blocks.en: 4 Technologies for perception and ambient systems
blocks.zh: 页:1 认知和环境系统技术

blocks.en: 1 Sensors and devices
blocks.zh: 1个传感器和装置

blocks.en:
Perception technologies are central to enabling robots and ambient systems to operate effectively in RAC and private homes. These environments impose unique constraints—cluttered layouts, variable lighting, mobility aids, and diverse sensory abilities—that shape sensing choices and integration strategies. Robust perception supports social engagement, health monitoring, safe navigation, and assistance with daily activities. The choice of sensors determines not only the functionality of these systems but also their acceptability, as issues of privacy, safety, cost, and usability are particularly sensitive in this context ( Costanzo et al., 2024 ) .
Fig. 6 summarises the main sensor categories across four system types: 1) Assistive/social robots, 2) Telepresence robots, 3) Domestic service robots, and 4) Ambient intelligence. While this taxonomy is useful for mapping device types, the following discussion focuses on functional roles and design considerations across five themes: vision-based sensing, auditory and speech-based sensing, tactile and physical interaction sensing, physiological and environmental sensing, and enabling infrastructure.
blocks.zh:
认知技术是使机器人和环境系统在RAC和私人家中有效运作的核心。 这些环境施加了独特的制约——布局复杂、照明变化不定、助行器和不同的感官能力——从而形成感知选择和融合战略。 强有力的观念支持社会参与、健康监测、安全航行以及协助日常活动。 传感器的选择不仅决定了这些系统的功能,而且还决定了其可接受性,因为隐私、安全、成本和可用性等问题在这方面特别敏感(Costanzo等人,2024年)。
图6概括了四个系统类型的主要传感器类别: (1) 辅助/社会机器人, (2) 远程机器人, 3)家庭服务机器人,4)安汶特智能. 虽然这种分类学对绘图设备类型有用,但以下讨论侧重于五个主题的功能作用和设计考虑因素:基于视觉的感知、听觉和语音的感知、触觉和物理相互作用感知、生理和环境感知以及有利的基础设施。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Taxonomy of sensors and devices across robotic systems in aged care.
blocks.zh: 图6:老年护理中机器人系统传感器和装置的分类。

blocks.en: Vision-based systems
blocks.zh: 基于愿景的系统

blocks.en: Vision sensors form the perceptual foundation of robotic systems. They enable scene understanding ( Fischinger et al., 2016 ) , object recognition ( Fischinger et al., 2016 ) , navigation ( Fischinger et al., 2016 ) , and social interaction ( McColl et al., 2016 ) . They provide rich detail but raise strong privacy concerns, requiring safeguards such as restricted fields of view, on-device processing, and selective triggering. Vision sensors include:
blocks.zh: 视觉传感器构成了机器人系统的感知基础. 它们能够理解场景(Fischinger等人,2016年),物体识别(Fischinger等人,2016年),导航 (Fischinger等人,2016年),与社会互动(McColl等人,2016年). 它们提供了内容丰富的细节,但引起了强烈的隐私关切,需要限制视野、设备处理和选择性触发等保障措施。 视觉传感器包括:

blocks.en:
• RGB cameras: RGB cameras are widely used in HRI systems. They enable functions such as face recognition ( Fahn et al., 2022 ) , activity recognition ( Sawik et al., 2023 ) , gesture interaction ( Sawik et al., 2023 ) , and fall detection ( Benkaci et al., 2024 ) , which are critical in aged care.
Challenges include privacy risks from continuous recording, sensitivity to lighting changes, and high computational demands.
Despite these challenges, RGB cameras remain a foundational sensing modality across multiple robotic systems in aged care due to their versatility and rich visual information. Mitigation strategies include on-device analysis, privacy-preserving video summarisation, and sparse event triggers that limit continuous recording in private spaces. • RGB-D cameras and depth cameras: RGB-D cameras combine colour and depth information to create a three-dimensional view of the environment, allowing robots to interpret spatial structures, recognise human postures, and navigate safely in cluttered or dynamic environments ( Fanello et al., 2014 ; Yang et al., 2020 ) . In aged care, RGB-D sensors have been successfully applied to fall detection, posture estimation, and gesture-based human-robot interaction.
Limitations include sensitivity to ambient lighting and reflective surfaces ( Sarbolandi et al., 2015 ) and increased computational demands. Although depth maps are less intrusive than RGB imagery, continuous 3D monitoring still raises privacy and acceptability concerns, and deployments often restrict depth capture to zones like beds or doorways. • LiDAR sensors: In aged care, LiDAR is primarily employed for safe robot navigation, environment mapping, and obstacle avoidance.
Its ability to generate accurate spatial models independent of lighting conditions makes it well-suited for both day and night operation, overcoming some of the limitations of camera-based systems ( Frøvik et al., 2021 ) .
However, LiDAR sensors are typically more expensive and power-intensive, which limits their inclusion in compact or low-cost devices. They also lack semantic detail, necessitating fusion with vision or auditory data for full situational awareness.
blocks.zh:
• RGB摄像头:RGB摄像头广泛用于HRI系统. 它们能够发挥诸如脸部识别(Fahn等人,2022年),活动识别(Sawik等人,2023年),手势互动(Sawik等人,2023年)和秋季检测(Benkaci等人,2024年)等功能,这些功能对老年护理至关重要。
挑战包括持续录制带来的隐私风险,对照明变化的敏感性,以及高计算需求.
尽管存在这些挑战,RGB相机由于其多面性和丰富的视觉信息,仍然是跨越老年护理的多个机器人系统的基础感知模式。 缓解战略包括在线设备分析、保存隐私的视频汇总以及限制在私人空间持续录制的稀有事件触发器。 • RGB-D相机和深度相机:RGB-D相机结合颜色和深度信息,形成三维环境视角,使机器人能够解释空间结构,识别人类姿势,并在杂乱或动态环境中安全导航(Fanello等人,2014年;杨等人,2020年). 在老年护理方面,RGB-D传感器已成功应用于秋季探测、姿态估计和手势人类-机器人互动。

Mitigation strategies include on-device analysis, privacy-preserving video summarisation, and sparse event triggers that limit continuous recording in private spaces.

blocks.en: Auditory and speech-based sensing
blocks.zh: 审计和语音感知

blocks.en: Auditory sensors enable robots to perceive and interpret sound, speech, and tone, facilitating natural interactions. Microphones, speaker arrays, and smart audio systems are commonly embedded in social and telepresence robots to facilitate communication, emotional engagement, and safety monitoring ( Christoforou et al., 2019 ; Costanzo et al., 2024 ) . While speech interfaces are intuitive, they remain vulnerable to noise and overlapping conversations.
blocks.zh: 审计传感器使机器人能够感知和解释声音、语音和语气,促进自然互动。 麦克风,扬声器阵列,智能音频系统通常嵌入社交和远程机器人中,以便于沟通,情感接触,以及安全监测(Christoforou等人,2019年;Costanzo等人,2024年). 虽然语音界面是直观的,但它们仍然容易受到噪音和重叠对话的伤害.

blocks.en:
• Microphones: Microphones serve as the audio input in assistive robots ( Fahn et al., 2022 ) , capturing speech and environmental sounds for tasks such as voice navigation, speech recognition, and distress detection ( Sawik et al., 2023 ) .
Many systems use simple classifiers to detect salient events such as shouts, glass breaking, or repeated coughing, which can be performed at a lower computational cost and with reduced privacy exposure compared with continuous speech transcription.
Challenges include background noise, multi-speaker interference, and continuous audio monitoring that can feel intrusive to residents and caregivers ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Designs that favour short buffered windows, on-device processing, and event summaries rather than raw audio streams can partially mitigate these concerns (see Section 5 ). • Speakers: Speakers enable robots to communicate verbally by delivering alerts, reminders, and navigation cues, as well as engaging in conversational interactions that support users’ mental and emotional well-being. Speech synthesis further facilitates naturalistic communication with residents, thereby improving both user acceptance and overall system usability ( Baltus et al., 2000 ) .
However, speaker-based systems must be designed to avoid disruption or annoyance. Volume, tone, and clarity are critical considerations. Coordinating speech output with visual or contextual cues from other sensors ensures coherent communication. Ethical considerations include avoiding deceptive or overly persuasive speech and ensuring that users can control or mute robot communication as desired ( Oliveira et al., 2017 ) . In practice, acoustic design for prompts and alerts should follow the accessibility and escalation principles in Section 3 .

• 支助 麦克风: 微型手机作为辅助机器人的音频输入(Fahn等人,2022年),为语音导航,语音识别,求救探测等任务捕捉语音和环境声音(Sawik等人,2023年).
许多系统使用简单的分类器来检测诸如喊叫,玻璃破碎,或重复咳嗽等突出事件,与连续的语音转录相比,可以以较低的计算成本进行,并减少隐私暴露.
挑战包括背景噪音、多语种干扰和不断的音频监测,它们可能使居民和照料者感到侵入性(徐等人,2025年)。 有利于短缓冲窗口、设备处理和事件摘要而非原始音频流的设计可以部分减轻这些关切(见第5节)。 • 发言者:发言者通过发出警报、提醒和导航提示,以及参与支持用户精神和情感福祉的对话互动,使机器人能够进行口头交流。 语音合成进一步促进了与居民的自然交流,从而提高了用户的接受程度和整个系统的可用性(Baltus等人,2000年)。
然而,基于演讲的系统的设计必须避免干扰或烦恼。 数量、语气和清晰度是关键考虑因素。 与其他传感器的视觉或背景提示协调语音输出,确保了连贯的沟通。 道德考虑包括避免欺骗性或过于说服性的言论,并确保用户能够按预期控制或哑弹机器人通信(Oliveira等人,2017年)。 在实践中,用于提示和警报的声学设计应遵循第3节中的无障碍和升级原则。

blocks.en: Tactile and physical interaction sensing
blocks.zh: 触控和物理相互作用感知

blocks.en: Tactile and force sensors allow robots to physically interact with users and their surroundings safely. They are crucial for tactile communication and for applications such as robotic feeding and mobility assistance, where physical contact is integral to function ( Topping, 2002 ) . Most current care home deployments involve limited or no physical manipulation, but safe touch sensing is a necessary condition for future assistance, for example, transfers, dressing, or feeding.
blocks.zh: Tactile和强迫传感器可以让机器人与用户及其周围安全地进行物理交互. 它们对于触觉交流以及机器人喂养和移动辅助等应用至关重要,因为身体接触是功能所不可或缺的(Topping,2002年)。 目前大多数护理家庭部署都涉及有限的或没有物理操控,但安全触摸感知是未来援助的一个必要条件,例如转移、敷扎或喂食。

blocks.en:
• Force and pressure sensors: Force and pressure sensors are critical for detecting contact forces during interaction with humans or objects. In aged care applications, they are integrated into robot joints, grippers, and support surfaces such as robotic arms, exoskeletons, or assistive beds to ensure gentle handling and to prevent injury ( Popovic, 2019 ) . Force and pressure sensors can be sensitive to calibration drift and mechanical wear, which may affect precision and reliability. Ensuring consistent performance requires careful sensor design, regular calibration, and the integration of redundant sensing modalities ( Billard and Kragic, 2019 ) . • Artificial skins and touch sensors: Artificial skins are arrays of distributed sensors that mimic human skin, enabling robots to detect contact location, magnitude, and texture ( Silvera-Tawil et al., 2015 ) . These sensors enhance safety by allowing robots to react immediately upon close proximity or touch, halting motion or adapting force before discomfort occurs. However, developing tactile materials and mechanisms that are durable, flexible, and sensitive remains an ongoing challenge. Many tactile sensors are prone to damage from wear, temperature changes, or humidity, limiting their long-term usability in domestic environments ( Silvera-Tawil et al., 2015 ; Kim et al., 2022 ) . • Proximity and contact sensors: Proximity sensors, such as infrared, capacitive, or ultrasonic sensors, allow robots to detect nearby obstacles and anticipate physical contact before it occurs ( Topping, 2002 ) . In care robots, they are vital for collision avoidance, safe navigation around people, and pre-contact detection during assistive interactions.
While proximity sensors enhance safety, they often provide limited spatial resolution and may be influenced by environmental factors like lighting or surface reflectivity, which necessitates combining proximity data with other complementary information ( Sawik et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
• 压力传感器: 力量和压力传感器对于探测与人类或物体相互作用时的接触力至关重要。 在老年护理应用中,它们被整合到机器人关节,抓手,并支持机器人手臂,外骨骼等表面或辅助床位,以确保温和的处理和防止受伤(Popovic, 2019). 压力传感器对校准漂移和机械磨损敏感,可能影响精度和可靠性. 确保一致的性能需要仔细的传感器设计,定期校准,并整合冗余感知模式(Billard and Kragic, 2019). ) • 人工皮肤和触摸传感器: 人工皮肤是模仿人类皮肤的分布式传感器阵列,使机器人能够检测接触位置,体积,纹理(Silvera-Tawil等人,2015年). 这些传感器通过允许机器人在接近或触碰时立即反应,在不适发生前停止运动或适应力来增强安全性. 然而,开发耐久、灵活和敏感的触觉材料和机制仍然是一个持续的挑战。 许多触觉传感器容易因磨损,温度变化或湿度而受损,限制了它们在国内环境中的长期可用性(Silvera-Tawil等人,2015年;Kim等人,2022年) ——近距离感应和接触感应器:近距离感应器,如红外线感应器,电容感应器,或超音速感应器,使机器人能够探测附近障碍,并预计发生物理接触(Topping,2002年). 在护理机器人中,它们对于避免碰撞,在人周围安全航行,以及在辅助性互动中进行接触前检测至关重要.
虽然近距离传感器可加强安全性,但它们往往提供有限的空间分辨率,并可能受到照明或表面反射等环境因素的影响,这就需要将近距离数据与其他补充信息结合起来(Sawik等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Physiological and environmental sensing
blocks.zh: 生理和环境感知

blocks.en: Wearables and ambient sensors monitor vital signs and environmental conditions, supporting context-aware assistance ( Song, 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . While these sensors enhance safety, they introduce challenges around accuracy, calibration, and privacy. Data typically flows through local hubs that aggregate signals and trigger alerts without exposing raw streams.
blocks.zh: 可穿戴物和环境传感器监测生命迹象和环境条件,支持环境认知援助(宋,2024;Lee等人,2025)。 虽然这些传感器加强了安全,但它们在准确性、校准和隐私方面提出了挑战。 数据一般通过局部中枢流动,这些中枢汇总信号和触发警报而不暴露原始流.

blocks.en:
• Physiological sensors: Physiological sensors measure biological signals such as heart rate, respiration, temperature or blood oxygen levels ( Mukhopadhyay and Gupta, 2007 ) . These can be embedded in wearable devices or integrated directly into robotic systems. In aged care, physiological sensing enables real-time monitoring of vital signs to detect abnormalities such as cardiac irregularities or respiratory distress.
Challenges include reduced accuracy affected by motion, sweat, and inconsistent skin contact, while discomfort may reduce long-term use ( Heikenfeld et al., 2018 ) . Reliable data interpretation remains challenging due to substantial individual variability, and the use of such information raises significant privacy concerns given the sensitivity of the associated health data. • Environmental sensors: Devices tracking temperature, humidity, air quality, and light provide context for safe and adaptive behaviour ( Duthie et al., 2024 ) . They complement physiological sensing by providing contextual awareness, but face challenges such as sensor calibration, drift, and false alarms caused by environmental fluctuations. Combining multiple streams of data requires sophisticated sensor fusion and decision-making frameworks to ensure reliable, actionable insights. Privacy concerns extend to continuous environmental monitoring, particularly when combined with vision or audio sensing that may inadvertently reveal personal habits or routines.

• 生理传感器: 生理传感器测量诸如心率、呼吸、温度或血氧水平等生物信号(Mukhopadhyay和Gupta,2007年)。 这些可以嵌入可穿戴设备或直接融入机器人系统. 在老年护理中,生理感知能够实时监测生命迹象,发现诸如心脏不正常或呼吸困难等异常情况。
挑战包括运动影响精度降低,汗,皮肤接触不一致,而不适则可能减少长期使用(Heikenfeld等人,2018年). 可靠的数据解释仍然具有挑战性,因为个人有很大的可变性,鉴于相关健康数据的敏感性,使用此类信息引起重大隐私关切。 • 环境传感器: 跟踪温度、湿度、空气质量和光线的装置为安全和适应行为提供了背景(Duthie等人,2024年)。 它们通过提供环境意识来补充生理感知,但面临诸如传感器校准、漂移和环境波动造成的假警报等挑战。 综合多种数据流需要复杂的传感器聚合和决策框架,以确保可靠和可操作的见解。 隐私问题包括持续的环境监测,特别是当与可能无意中暴露个人习惯或习惯的视觉或音频感知相结合时。

blocks.en:
Physiological sensors: Physiological sensors measure biological signals such as heart rate, respiration, temperature or blood oxygen levels ( Mukhopadhyay and Gupta, 2007 ) . These can be embedded in wearable devices or integrated directly into robotic systems. In aged care, physiological sensing enables real-time monitoring of vital signs to detect abnormalities such as cardiac irregularities or respiratory distress.
Challenges include reduced accuracy affected by motion, sweat, and inconsistent skin contact, while discomfort may reduce long-term use ( Heikenfeld et al., 2018 ) . Reliable data interpretation remains challenging due to substantial individual variability, and the use of such information raises significant privacy concerns given the sensitivity of the associated health data.

blocks.en: Environmental sensors: Devices tracking temperature, humidity, air quality, and light provide context for safe and adaptive behaviour ( Duthie et al., 2024 ) . They complement physiological sensing by providing contextual awareness, but face challenges such as sensor calibration, drift, and false alarms caused by environmental fluctuations. Combining multiple streams of data requires sophisticated sensor fusion and decision-making frameworks to ensure reliable, actionable insights. Privacy concerns extend to continuous environmental monitoring, particularly when combined with vision or audio sensing that may inadvertently reveal personal habits or routines.

blocks.en: In practice, most sensing occurs through ambient or wearable devices rather than the robot alone, feeding into shared event and alert channels (Section 3 ), with the privacy implications discussed in Section 5 .

blocks.en: Technology enabling infrastructure
blocks.zh: 技术扶持基础设施

blocks.en: Enabling infrastructure comprises the foundational systems that support sensing and robotic technologies, including IoT frameworks, wireless networks, edge and cloud computing, and data management architectures ( Costanzo et al., 2024 ) . These components enable seamless coordination and responsive care environments. Architectural patterns should prioritise local inference, minimal data flows, and resilience under network loss, aligning with privacy-by-design principles discussed in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 扶持性基础设施包括支持遥感和机器人技术的基础系统,包括IOT框架、无线网络、边缘和云计算以及数据管理架构(Costanzo等人,2024年)。 这些组成部分能够实现无缝协调和反应灵敏的护理环境。 建筑模式应优先考虑局部推论、最低数据流量和网络损失后的复原力,与第3节讨论的逐个设计原则保持一致。

blocks.en: 2 Scene understanding and mapping
blocks.zh: 2个 场景理解和绘图

blocks.en: Scene understanding and mapping are critical capabilities for robotic systems operating in RAC and home environments. These systems must navigate safely around residents, mobility aids, and personal belongings while performing tasks such as fetch-and-carry, monitoring, social interaction, and fall detection ( Ni et al., 2023 ) . Unlike controlled laboratory settings, aged-care settings are highly dynamic and unpredictable environments, so robots require robust, context-aware scene understanding tailored to care scenarios rather than generic indoor navigation (see Section 2 ).
blocks.zh: 场景理解和绘图是机器人系统在RAC和家庭环境中运行的关键能力. 这些系统必须在居民、助行器和个人物品周围安全地航行,同时执行诸如取货、监测、社会互动和秋季探测等任务(Ni等人,2023年)。 与受控制的实验室环境不同,老年护理环境是高度动态和不可预测的环境,因此机器人需要根据护理情景,而非通用室内导航,进行强健的,有环境意识的场景理解(见第2节).

blocks.en: Current approaches rely on multi-modal sensing using the devices described in Section 1 to combine visual, depth, and non-visual information. RGB-D cameras are commonly used for capturing both appearance and geometry, supporting depth-based object detection and mapping. Complementary sensors such as inertial units, thermal cameras, radar, and ambient IoT devices add resilience when visual sensing is impaired ( Duncan et al., 2024 ) . Beyond 2D perception, semantic simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM) integrates geometric mapping with object labels, allowing robots to reason about spatial relationships such as the proximity of a walking frame to a bed or the typical route between a resident’s chair and the bathroom ( Hing et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 目前的办法依靠利用第1节所述装置的多式遥感,将视觉、深度和非视觉信息结合起来。 RGB-D相机通常用于捕捉外观和几何,支持基于深度的物体探测和绘图. 辅助传感器,如惯性单元、热相机、雷达以及环境IOT设备,在视觉感知受损时会增加复原力(Duncan等人,2024年)。 在2D感知之外,语义同步本地化和绘图(SLAM)将几何映射与物体标签融合在一起,使机器人能够对空间关系进行推理,如行走框架靠近床位或居民椅与浴室之间的典型路线(Hing等人,2020年).

blocks.en: Despite recent progress, reliable scene understanding in care environments remains challenging because clutter, dynamic lighting, and frequent occlusions degrade perception ( Schuster et al., 2010 ; Hung et al., 2022b ) . Layouts differ across homes, furniture and personal items move over time, and residents may use mobility aids or medical devices that complicate visual interpretation. Models trained on public datasets often fail to generalise without extensive adaptation, and long-term deployment introduces further complexity as robots must track gradual environmental and behavioural changes rather than assuming a static map.
blocks.zh: 尽管最近取得了进展,但在护理环境中可靠的场景理解仍然具有挑战性,因为杂乱无章、动态照明和频繁的隔离会降低感知(Shuster等人,2010年;Hung等人,2022b)。 不同家庭、家具和个人物品随时间而移动的布局不同,居民可能使用助行器或医疗器械,使视觉翻译复杂化。 接受过公共数据集培训的模型往往无法在没有广泛适应的情况下通用,而长期部署带来了进一步的复杂性,因为机器人必须跟踪逐渐的环境和行为变化,而不是假设静态地图.

blocks.en: Privacy introduces additional constraints ( Rigaud et al., 2024 ) . In this vein, privacy-preserving perception has become an increasingly active area of research within mapping and scene understanding ( Taras et al., 2024 ) . Many systems now avoid storing raw RGB data and instead rely on mapping data to privacy-preserving representations such as texture-free geometric maps, semantic maps without visual appearance, blurred or downsampled point clouds, and topological maps that encode only key locations (e.g., “bed area” or “bathroom entrance”), without detailed imagery ( Taras et al., 2024 ) . These maps allow robots to perform navigation and assistive tasks while reducing risks related to surveillance, consent, or data retention.
blocks.zh: 隐私带来额外限制 (Rigaud等人,2024年). 因此,保护隐私的感知已成为制图和场景理解方面日益活跃的研究领域(Taras等人,2024年)。 许多系统现在避免储存原始的RGB数据,而是依靠绘图数据来保持隐私,如无纹理几何图,无视觉外观的语义图,模糊或下取样的点云,以及只编码关键位置的地形图(如“床位”或“洗手间入口”),没有详细的图像(Taras等人,2024年)。 这些地图允许机器人执行导航和辅助任务,同时减少与监视,同意或数据保存有关的风险.

blocks.en: From a technical perspective, real-time processing on embedded hardware poses further limitations. Achieving accurate perception under power and latency constraints is challenging, especially when robots must process multi-modal data continuously in shared spaces. Efficient architectures, model compression, and on-device inference strategies are therefore essential for practical deployment ( Rout et al., 2024 ; Zijiang et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 从技术角度看,嵌入式硬件上的实时处理造成了进一步的限制. 在权力和暂时性的限制下实现准确的认知是困难的,特别是在机器人必须在共享空间中连续处理多模式数据的情况下。 因此,高效的架构、模型压缩和立体推导战略对于实际部署至关重要(Rout等人,2024年;Zijiang等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: 3 Human perception
blocks.zh: 3. 人的认识

blocks.en: Robotic and intelligent systems provide a suite of capabilities that enable machines to interpret and respond to human presence, actions, and emotional states. Recent advances in computer vision and machine learning have significantly improved performance across detection, tracking, pose estimation, gesture recognition, fall detection, and affect recognition, making these technologies increasingly viable for assistive and aged care environments.
blocks.zh: 机器人和智能系统提供了一套能力,使机器能够解释和应对人类的存在、行动和情感状态。 计算机视觉和机器学习方面的最新进展大大改进了各种探测、跟踪、提出估计、手势识别、秋季检测以及影响识别的绩效,使这些技术对辅助和老年护理环境越来越可行。

blocks.en: • Human detection and tracking: Contemporary human detection and tracking systems leverage deep learning object detectors such as YOLO ( Reis et al., 2023 ) and transformer-based architectures ( Meinhardt et al., 2022 ; Gopal and Amer, 2024 ) , often integrated with multi-object tracking algorithms like ByteTrack ( Zhang et al., 2022b ) for robust performance in dynamic environments. These systems excel in multi-camera setups, enabling persistent tracking across viewpoints despite occlusions and illumination changes, and in care settings, they support tasks such as monitoring corridor use or checking whether a resident has returned to bed. LiDAR-assisted detection ( Du and Beltrame, 2024 ) and radar-based sensing are emerging as privacy-preserving alternatives, offering resilience under poor lighting and clutter. Challenges remain in achieving real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms and ensuring robustness under diverse environmental conditions. • Pose and gesture recognition: Human pose estimation has evolved from 2D keypoint detection to 3D reconstruction using monocular RGB inputs ( Yiannakides et al., 2019 ) , multi-view systems, and hybrid sensor fusion ( Bao et al., 2024 ) . Deep learning approaches incorporating convolutional neural networks ( Luo et al., 2018 ) , graph-based models ( Zou and Tang, 2021 ) , and transformers ( Fu et al., 2023 ) dominate the field, with recent innovations such as diffusion models ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) and efficient tokenization strategies ( Li et al., 2024b ) reducing computational overhead while maintaining accuracy. These methods enable fine-grained gesture recognition critical for natural human-robot interaction. Despite progress, occlusion handling and generalisation to real-world scenarios remain open challenges, particularly in aged care settings where mobility aids and furniture introduce visual complexity and where residents may have a limited range of motion. • Fall detection: Vision-based fall detection systems increasingly integrate pose estimation with anomaly detection frameworks to distinguish falls from normal activities. Transformer-based architectures ( Al-qaness et al., 2024 ; McCall et al., 2024 ) combined with lightweight deployment strategies (e.g., on edge devices) have demonstrated high accuracy while preserving privacy through local processing. Emerging approaches also explore multi-modal sensing, including radar and depth cameras ( Cippitelli et al., 2017 ) , to overcome limitations of RGB imaging under occlusion or poor lighting. Nonetheless, dataset scarcity for real-world falls and the need for unobtrusive monitoring remain significant barriers to widespread adoption in care homes and private houses. • Affect recognition: Affect recognition has progressed beyond facial expression analysis to incorporate body pose ( Filntisis et al., 2019 ) , contextual cues ( Han and Gratch, 2025 ) , and multi-modal fusion of visual, vocal, and physiological signals ( Udahemuka et al., 2024 ) . Vision-language models ( Bhattacharyya and Wang, 2025 ) and diffusion-based frameworks ( Hassan et al., 2024 ) now enable context-aware emotion inference, addressing limitations of earlier facial-only approaches. Micro-expression detection ( Verburg and Menkovski, 2019 ) and transformer-based architectures ( Zhang et al., 2022a ; Vazquez-Rodriguez et al., 2022 ) further enhance robustness in real-world conditions. However, challenges persist in data availability, cultural variability in emotional expression, and ethical considerations surrounding privacy and consent in continuous monitoring, especially when systems infer affect implicitly rather than through explicit check-ins.
blocks.zh: • 人类探测和跟踪: 当代人类探测和跟踪系统利用了YOLO(Reis等人,2023年)和变压器基于架构(Meinhardt等人,2022年;Gopal和Amer,2024年)等深层学习对象探测器,常与ByteTrack(张等人,2022年b)等多对象跟踪算法结合,在动态环境中实现强效. 这些系统在多镜头布局方面非常出色,尽管存在隐蔽和照明变化,但仍能持续地进行各种观点的跟踪,在护理环境中,它们支持监测走廊使用情况或检查居民是否已经回到床上等任务。 LiDAR辅助探测(Du and Beltrame,2024年)和基于雷达的遥感正在成为保护隐私的替代方法,在灯光差和杂乱的情况下提供复原力。 在资源紧张的平台上实现实时业绩和确保在不同环境条件下的稳健性方面仍然存在挑战。 • 胸罩和手势识别: 人类姿势估计由2D键点检测演化为3D重建,使用单聚RGB输入(Yiannakides等人,2019年),多视系统,以及混合传感器聚变(Bao等人,2024年). 深度学习方法融入了进化神经网络(Luo等人,2018年),图定模型(Zou and Tang,2021年),变压器(Fu等人,2023年)在领域占据主导地位,传播模型(Cheng等人,2024年)等近期创新,高效的标语化战略(Li等人,2024年b)在保持准确性的同时降低计算间接费用. 这些方法使得精细的手势识别成为自然人与机器人相互作用的关键. 尽管取得了进展,但隔离处理和对现实世界情景的概括仍然是公开的挑战,特别是在老年护理环境中,行动辅助器和家具具有视觉复杂性,居民的运动范围可能有限。 • 支助 秋季检测 : 基于远景的秋季探测系统越来越多地将预测与异常探测框架结合起来,以区别秋季与正常活动。 基于变形器的架构 (Al-qaness等人, 2024年;McCall等人, 2024年)与轻量级部署策略(如在边缘装置上)相结合,在通过局部处理维护隐私的同时,表现出高度的准确性. 新兴方法还探索多模式感知,包括雷达和深度相机(Cippitelli等人,2017年),以克服闭塞或照明不良下RGB成像的局限性. 然而,现实世界的数据集匮乏,需要进行无侵扰性监测,这仍然是护理院和私人住房广泛采用的重大障碍。 • 支助 影响识别 : 除了面部表情分析之外,感染识别已经取得进展,以纳入身体姿势(Filntisis等人,2019年),背景提示(Han和Gratch,2025年),以及视觉、声乐和生理信号的多模式融合(Udahemuka等人,2024年)。 视觉语言模型(Bhattacharyya and Wang, 2025)和基于传播的框架(Hassan等人, 2024年)现在可以进行上下文感知的情感推论,解决早期只面部方法的局限性. 微表情探测(Verburg and Menkovski, 2019)和变压器基架构(Zhang等人, 2022a;Vazquez-Rodriguez等人, 2022)进一步加强了现实世界条件下的稳健性. 然而,在数据的可得性、情感表达的文化差异、以及持续监测中围绕隐私和同意的道德考虑方面仍然存在挑战,特别是当系统推断暗含影响而不是通过明确的登机检查。

blocks.zh: 影响识别 : 除了面部表情分析之外,感染识别已经取得进展,以纳入身体姿势(Filntisis等人,2019年),背景提示(Han和Gratch,2025年),以及视觉、声乐和生理信号的多模式融合(Udahemuka等人,2024年)。 视觉语言模型(Bhattacharyya and Wang, 2025)和基于传播的框架(Hassan等人, 2024年)现在可以进行上下文感知的情感推论,解决早期只面部方法的局限性. 微表情探测(Verburg and Menkovski, 2019)和变压器基架构(Zhang等人, 2022a;Vazquez-Rodriguez等人, 2022)进一步加强了现实世界条件下的稳健性. 然而,在数据的可得性、情感表达的文化差异、以及持续监测中围绕隐私和同意的道德考虑方面仍然存在挑战,特别是当系统推断暗含影响而不是通过明确的登机检查。

blocks.en: 4 Learning paradigms in robotics for RAC and home care
blocks.zh: 4 机器人学模式,用于RAC和家庭护理

blocks.en: Introduction to learning paradigms in HRI
blocks.zh: 人权学习范式介绍

blocks.en: As assistive technologies enter home and RAC settings, robots must learn and adapt to dynamic, personalised environments. Learning paradigms, the frameworks through which robots acquire and refine knowledge, are central to this adaptability. These range from supervised learning, reliant on labelled data, to weakly-supervised, self-supervised, and few-shot approaches that reduce annotation needs. Domain adaptation enables models trained in controlled settings to function in diverse real homes. Fig. 7 illustrates these techniques and their challenges.
blocks.zh: 随着辅助技术进入家用和RAC设置,机器人必须学习并适应动态,个性化的环境. 学习模式是机器人获取和完善知识的框架,是这种适应性的核心。 这些方法包括监督学习、依赖标签数据、监督不力、自我监督、减少注释需要的少见方法。 域内适应使在受控环境中接受培训的模型能够在不同的真实家庭发挥作用。 图7说明了这些技术及其挑战。

blocks.en: Supervised learning approaches
blocks.zh: 监督学习方法

blocks.en: Supervised learning remains one of the most fundamental and widely used paradigms in robotics in care settings. It trains models on datasets where each input is paired with a corresponding label, enabling the system to learn a mapping from inputs to outputs. In typical pipelines, multimodal data streams (e.g., RGB video, audio, inertial data) are annotated with ground-truth labels such as activities, spoken commands, or gestures, and used to train deep architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, Transformers) that minimise a task loss via back-propagation. Once validated on held-out data, these models are deployed and may be fine-tuned for specific homes or devices.
blocks.zh: 监督学习仍然是护理环境中机器人领域最根本和最广泛使用的模式之一。 它在数据集上培训模型,每个输入都配有相应的标签,使系统能够学习从输入到输出的映射. 在典型的管道中,多式数据流(如RGB视频,音频,惯性数据)被附加地面真实标记,如活动,口语命令,或手势等,并用于训练深层架构(如CNN,RNN,变形器),通过反向传播将任务损失最小化. 这些模型一旦在搁置数据上得到验证,即可部署,并可对特定住宅或装置进行微调。

blocks.en: In home and RAC HRI, this pipeline underpins many core capabilities, for example, activity recognition for monitoring, speech recognition for voice commands, and gesture interpretation for safe interaction. Rather than detailing the generic pipeline, we focus on representative state-of-the-art extensions and applications that illustrate how these methods address care-specific challenges.
blocks.zh: 在国内和RAC HRI中,这一管道是许多核心能力的基础,例如监测的活动识别、语音指令的语音识别以及安全互动的手势解释。 我们不是详细介绍通用程序,而是侧重于有代表性的最新扩展和应用,说明这些方法如何应对护理方面的具体挑战。

blocks.en: • Activity recognition: Supervised learning enables robots to identify ADLs like eating or walking. Recent work uses multi-modal fusion of RGB, depth, and inertial data for robust classification. Robinson and Nejat ( Robinson and Nejat, 2023 ) introduced spatial mid-fusion for integrating geometric and semantic features, while RNNs mitigate observation noise ( Mihoub, 2021 ) . Modern models like DeepConvLSTM and attention-based architectures improve temporal reasoning and interpretability in cluttered homes. • Speech recognition: Transformer-based ASR systems such as Conformer ( Gulati et al., 2020 ) and Whisper ( Radford et al., 2023 ) achieve state-of-the-art by combining convolution and self-attention. Parameter-efficient prompt tuning ( Ma et al., 2024 ) enables personalisation with minimal overhead. Domain-specific fine-tuning and end-to-end pipelines improve robustness in home-care contexts ( Pallavoor et al., 2024 ) . • Gesture recognition: Shifted from rule-based to deep learning using RGB-D cameras and graph neural networks ( Świetlicka, 2025 ) . DiG-Net ( Beeri et al., 2025 ) achieves 97.3% accuracy with depth-conditioned alignment for long-range gestures, while GestLLM ( Kobzarev et al., 2025 ) combines MediaPipe features with LLMs to interpret culturally nuanced gestures without retraining.
blocks.zh: • 支助 活动识别: 监督学习使机器人能够识别ADL像吃或走路. 最近的工作利用RGB、深度和惯性数据的多模式聚合来进行强力分类。 Robinson和Nejat(Robinson和Nejat,2023年)引入了空间中聚,以整合几何和语义特征,而RNNs则减轻观测噪音(Mihoub,2021年). 诸如DeepConvLSTM和基于关注的建筑等现代模型在杂乱的住宅中改善了时间推理和可解释性. • 语音识别: 基于变形器的ASR系统如Conformer(Gulati等人,2020年)和Whisper(Radford等人,2023年)通过结合进化和自觉实现最新. 参数高效的即时调理(Ma等人,2024年)使个性化和最小的间接费用成为可能。 专门针对域的微调和端到端的管道在家庭护理环境中提高稳健性(Pallavor等人,2024年). 手势识别: 使用RGB-D相机和图表神经网络从基于规则的学习转向深入学习( wietlicka,2025). DiG-Net(Beili等人,2025年) 97.3%的精确度,对远程手势进行深度条件调整,而GestLLM(Kobzarev等人,2025年)结合了Media 配有LLMS的管道功能,在不进行再培训的情况下解释文化上的细微姿态.
