blocks.en: Despite its widespread success, supervised learning faces major hurdles in home and RAC robotics. Data annotation is a key barrier: creating labelled datasets is costly and time-intensive. Annotating RGB-D video, LiDAR, and audio streams demands expertise and specialised tools, especially for segmenting continuous video and verifying object interactions. Domain mismatch compounds this challenge, with models trained in labs often failing in the real world.
blocks.zh: 监督学习尽管取得了广泛成功,但在家庭和RAC机器人方面面临重大障碍。 数据注释是一个关键障碍:创建贴有标签的数据集成本高昂,而且耗费时间。 标注RGB-D视频,LiDAR和音频流需要专业知识和专门工具,特别是用于分割连续视频和验证对象交互. 域不匹配使这一挑战复杂化,在实验室中训练的模型在现实世界中经常失败.

blocks.en: Generalisation remains limited. Supervised models tend to overfit to training data and struggle with rare activities or atypical gestures, or speech patterns common in older adults. Finally, scalability and privacy introduce ethical constraints. Collecting large-scale labelled data in private homes conflicts with autonomy and data protection principles, making continuous monitoring impractical and reinforcing the need for privacy-preserving alternatives.
blocks.zh: 普遍性仍然有限。 监督模型往往过于适合训练数据,与罕见的活动或非典型的手势,或老年人常见的言语模式进行斗争. 最后,可伸缩性和隐私带来了道德限制。 在私人家中收集大规模贴有标签的数据与自主性和数据保护原则相冲突,使持续监测不切实际,并更加需要保护隐私的替代办法。

blocks.en: Weakly-supervised and self-supervised learning approaches
blocks.zh: 监督薄弱,自我监督的学习方式.

blocks.en: Traditional supervised learning relies on large, fully annotated datasets, which are expensive and time-consuming to create. Weakly-supervised learning (WSL) relaxes this requirement by using incomplete, inexact, or noisy labels, for example, coarse timestamps or video-level tags instead of frame-level annotations. Self-supervised learning (SSL) goes a step further by eliminating manual labels entirely. It leverages the intrinsic structure of the data to create pseudo-labels or predictive tasks, such as predicting missing frames in a video or reconstructing masked audio segments. Both paradigms aim to exploit unlabelled or weakly labelled data that can be collected passively, reducing annotation costs.
blocks.zh: 传统的有监督的学习依赖于大型的,充分注解的数据集,这些数据集的创建既昂贵又费时. 弱监督的学习(WSL)通过使用不完整,不准确,或吵闹的标签来放松这一要求,例如粗细的时间戳或视频级别标记而不是帧级别说明. 自我监督的学习(SSL)更进一步,完全取消了手动标签. 它利用数据的内在结构来创建伪标签或预测性任务,比如在视频中预测缺失的帧或者重建蒙面音频片段. 这两个范例都旨在利用可以被动收集的无标签或标签薄弱的数据,降低注释成本。

blocks.en: WSL has gained traction in HRI for tasks where fine-grained annotation is impractical. For example, in action segmentation, Yang et al. (2023) introduced Action-Union Learning, which uses timestamp-level annotations instead of frame-wise labels, achieving near-supervised performance with less than 1% of full labels. In object detection, Maiettini et al. (2021) proposed a teacher-learner pipeline for humanoid robots, combining weak supervision with online learning to adapt detection models in real time, reducing labelling effort while leveraging robot usage for active data acquisition. Similarly, domain adaptation with weak supervision has been explored by Wilson et al. (2020) , who developed CoDATS, a multi-source adaptation framework for time-series sensor data that incorporates weak supervision signals such as label distributions, improving activity recognition across heterogeneous home environments. Finally, for activity recognition, semantic-guided attention mechanisms have been used to eliminate the need for bounding box annotations and reduce computational overhead ( Liu et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: WSL在HRI中获得了对于细加注释不切实际的任务的牵引力. 例如,在动作分割中,杨等人(2023年)引入了Action-Union Learning,使用时间戳级说明而不是帧式标签,以不足1%的完整标签实现近监督性能. 在物体检测方面,Maiettini等人(2021年)提议为人造机器人提供师-雷纳管道,将薄弱的监管与在线学习结合起来,实时调整检测模型,减少标签工作,同时利用机器人的使用来积极获取数据. 同样,Wilson等人(2020年)也探讨了在监督薄弱的情况下对域的适应问题,他们开发了CoDATS,这是一个用于时间序列传感器数据的多源适应框架,其中包含了标签分配等薄弱的监督信号,改进了不同家庭环境中的活动识别。 最后,对于活动识别,使用了语义引导的注意机制,消除了对框注的需要,减少了计算间接费用(Liu等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: SSL enables robots to learn rich representations from raw sensory streams without manual labels, making it highly relevant for HRI in low-resource and privacy-sensitive settings. In speech and multi-modal interaction, SSL has transformed automatic speech recognition (ASR) through models such as wav2vec 2.0 and HuBERT, which learn robust audio embeddings by predicting masked segments, significantly reducing dependence on labelled speech data. These embeddings are now integrated into multi-modal HRI systems for voice-enabled assistive robots ( Mohamed et al., 2022 ) . Similarly, Pan et al. (2022) leveraged unimodal SSL for audio-visual speech recognition, pretraining audio and visual encoders separately and then fusing them for lip-reading tasks, improving robustness in noisy environments where visual cues complement degraded audio. Beyond speech, SSL has advanced robotic manipulation and self-modelling: Florence et al. (2019) introduced a video prediction-based approach that enables robots to anticipate object trajectories and arm movements, supporting zero-shot transfer to new tasks in home environments. Likewise, Mezghani et al. (2023) demonstrated goal-conditioned SSL for manipulation, allowing robots to infer task goals from visual cues and adapt actions accordingly, reducing reliance on human-provided demonstrations.
blocks.zh: SSL使机器人能够在没有手动标签的原始感官流中学习丰富的表现,使其在资源低和对隐私敏感的环境下与HRI高度相关. 在语音和多模式互动中,SSL通过wav2vec 2.0和HuBERT等模型,转变了自动语音识别(ASR),通过预测蒙蔽的片段来学习强固的音频嵌入,大大减少了对标注语音数据的依赖. 这些嵌入物现已纳入语音辅助机器人的多模式HRI系统(Mohamed等人,2022年)。 同样, 潘等编著. (2022年)利用单模式SSL进行视听语音识别,对音频和视频编码器分别进行预训,然后将其引信用于唇读任务,在视觉提示补充退化音频的吵闹环境中提高稳健性. 除了演讲之外,SSL还拥有先进的机器人操控和自我建模: Florence et al. (2019)引入了基于视频预测的方法,使机器人能够预测物体的轨迹和手臂运动,支持零射转动到家庭环境中的新任务. 同样,Mezghani等人(2023年)展示了用于操纵的有目标条件的SSL,允许机器人从视觉提示中推断任务目标并相应调整行动,从而减少对人提供的演示的依赖.

blocks.en: Despite their promise, WSL and SSL have notable limitations. WSL often relies on heuristic labels or coarse annotations, which can introduce noise and ambiguity; models may overfit to incorrect patterns, reducing reliability in safety-critical assistive tasks. It also does not eliminate the need for domain adaptation; models trained on partially labelled datasets may still struggle with cultural and environmental variability in homes.
blocks.zh: 尽管他们的承诺,WSL和SSL有显著的局限性. WSL经常依赖于高压标签或粗糙的说明,这可以引入噪音和模糊;模型可能过度适应不正确的模式,降低安全关键辅助任务的可靠性. 它还没有消除对域域适应的需要;在部分标注数据集方面接受培训的模型仍然可能与家庭的文化和环境变异性发生矛盾。

blocks.en: SSL, while reducing annotation costs, introduces different challenges. Designing effective pretext tasks that transfer well to downstream HRI applications remains difficult, since predicting masked video frames or audio segments may not directly improve gesture recognition or activity classification without extensive fine-tuning. SSL methods also demand significant computational resources for large-scale pretraining, which may be impractical for resource-constrained robots. Both paradigms share issues of limited interpretability, raising concerns about transparency and trust in care contexts. Finally, collecting raw sensory data for pretraining raises privacy-related ethical concerns.
blocks.zh: SSL在降低注释成本的同时,也带来了不同的挑战. 设计有效的借口任务,将大量传输到下游的HRI应用仍然很困难,因为如果不进行广泛的微调,预测蒙面的视频帧或音频片段可能无法直接改善手势识别或活动分类. SSL方法还需要大量用于大规模预训的计算资源,这对于受资源限制的机器人可能不切实际. 这两种模式都存在可解释性有限的问题,使人们对照料情况下的透明度和信任感到关切。 最后,为预训收集原始感官数据引起了与隐私有关的道德问题。

blocks.en: Few-shot and meta-learning approaches
blocks.zh: 少发和元学习方法

blocks.en: In RAC and home care, robots must adapt quickly to new users, layouts, and routines with only a handful of examples. Unlike traditional systems needing large datasets, few-shot and meta-learning enable rapid adaptation with minimal input. Few-shot learning generalises from limited examples, ideal for scenarios where collecting extensive data is impractical or intrusive. A robot might learn routines, dietary needs, or communication styles from just a few interactions, supporting personalised assistance and trust. Compared to supervised learning, which demands labelled data, few-shot learning is inherently suited to data-scarce environments.
blocks.zh: 在RAC与家庭护理中,机器人必须快速适应新用户,布局,以及只有少数例子的常规. 与传统系统需要大型数据集不同,少拍少学和元学习能够快速适应,投入极少。 对收集大量数据不切实际或具有侵扰性的情况来说,这是理想的。 机器人可能从一些互动中学习常规,饮食需求,或交流风格,支持个性化的援助和信任. 与需要贴标签数据的有监督的学习相比,很少的速成学习本质上适合数据稀缺的环境。

blocks.en: Few-shot learning is most useful during onboarding or change, when residents move rooms or adopt new routines, allowing robots to update behaviours without full retraining. Meta-learning underpins this capability by teaching robots how to adapt across tasks rather than memorising routines. Frameworks like MAML and Prototypical Networks train on diverse scenarios, enabling quick fine-tuning in real homes. In this chapter, meta-learning is considered not as an abstract concept but as a practical tool for safe, low-effort personalisation across varied homes, languages, and care routines.
blocks.zh: 在登机或换机时,当居民移动房间或采用新的例行程序时,很少的速成学习最有用,允许机器人更新行为而无需完全再培训. Meta-learning通过教机器人如何适应各种任务,而不是记忆性地例行公事来支撑这种能力. MAML和原型网络等框架就不同的情况进行训练,使真正的家庭能够快速微调。 在本章中,元学习不被认为是抽象的概念,而是在不同的家庭、语言和护理常规中安全、低功率个性化的实用工具。

blocks.en: Few-shot learning has advanced significantly for aged care applications. The VITAL framework ( Kasaei and Kasaei, 2024 ) combines few-shot imitation learning with human-in-the-loop corrections, enabling robots to learn tasks such as setting trays or stacking objects from only a few demonstrations, augmented by simulation and feedback. Similarly, Wi-Fi-based sensing ( Wang et al., 2024 ) applies few-shot learning to detect activities like falls without intrusive sensors, supporting privacy-preserving monitoring. For personalisation, preference-based action representation ( Wang et al., 2025 ) allows robots to fine-tune behaviours—such as feeding angles or tone—from minimal user feedback. Meta-learning further drives cross-task adaptability: approaches like variational meta-RL ( Ballou et al., 2023 ) help robots adjust to different reward functions, while trust modelling ( Gao et al., 2019 ) fosters rapport in long-term care. Meta-imitation learning enables skill generalisation from limited demonstrations, supported by benchmarks such as Meta-World ( Yu et al., 2020 ) . Finally, meta-learning integrates with adaptive control for fine motor tasks, as in peg-in-hole assembly ( Johannsmeier et al., 2019 ) , combining skill formalism with meta-parameter learning for precision tasks like assistive device maintenance.
blocks.zh: 在老年护理应用方面,少有学习进展。 VITAL框架(Kasaei和Kasaei,2024年)结合了几发模仿学习和人入校正,使机器人能够从仅少数的演示中学习诸如设置托盘或堆放物体等任务,并通过模拟和反馈加以补充. 同样,基于Wi-Fi的感测(Wang et al., 2024)应用了几发的学习来探测像坠落那样没有侵入传感器的活动,支持隐私保护监测. 就个性化而言,基于偏好的行动表现(Wang等人,2025年)允许机器人从最低限度的用户反馈中微调行为——如喂食角度或语气. Meta-learning进一步驱动跨任务适应性:变异元-RL(Ballou等人,2023年)等方法帮助机器人适应不同的奖励功能,而信任建模(Gao等人,2019年)则在长期关怀中培育关系. Meta-imitation学习使得技能从有限的演示中概括化,并得到了Meta-World(Yu等人,2020年)等基准的支持. 最后,元学习结合了精细运动任务的适应性控制,如孔内装配(Johannsmeier et al., 2019),将技能形式主义与元参数学习相结合,用于辅助设备维护等精密任务.

blocks.en: Despite their promise, few-shot and meta-learning approaches face several challenges. First, task diversity and complexity can limit generalisation: while these methods excel at adapting to simple routines or object manipulation, highly variable activities (e.g., culturally nuanced interactions) remain difficult to learn from only a few examples. Robustness and interpretability are also concerns; systems can be brittle and opaque, limiting caregiver oversight. Moreover, meta-learning adds complexity: training across diverse tasks demands large datasets or simulations, which are costly. Models may overfit to seen tasks and fail when behaviours differ, as assumptions about shared structure often break in personalised care. Both paradigms rely on limited or implicit feedback, yet older adults may provide unclear signals, and caregivers lack time for fine-tuning. This gap between theory and practice raises ethical risks: incorrect adaptation could harm or undermine dignity.
blocks.zh: 尽管他们有承诺,但少见和元学习的方法面临若干挑战。 首先,任务的多样性和复杂性可以限制概括性:虽然这些方法在适应简单的例行程序或物体操纵方面表现优异,但高度可变的活动(如文化上的细微互动)仍然难以仅从几个例子中学习. 强健性和可解释性也是令人关切的问题;系统可能不透明,限制了照料者的监督。 此外,元学习增加了复杂性:不同任务之间的培训需要大型数据集或模拟,费用高昂。 模型可能过于适合所看到的任务,并在行为不同时失效,因为关于共同结构的假设往往会打破个性化护理。 这两种模式都依赖有限的或含蓄的反馈,但老年人可能提供不明确的信号,而照顾者缺乏微调的时间。 这种理论与实践之间的差距带来了道德风险:不正确的适应可能损害或损害尊严。

blocks.en: In summary, while promising for personalisation, few-shot and meta-learning face hurdles in data quality, robustness, interpretability, computational cost, and ethics that must be addressed for real-world deployment.
blocks.zh: 简言之,在希望个性化的同时,少有镜头和元学习在数据质量、稳健性、可解释性、计算成本和道德方面面临障碍,而现实世界的部署必须解决这些障碍。

blocks.en: Domain adaptation for home environments
blocks.zh: 适应家庭环境的领域

blocks.en: As robots move from lab settings to home and RAC settings, they face a number of challenges. Domain adaptation (DA) addresses these gaps so models trained in one domain (e.g., simulation or benchmark datasets) remain reliable in real-world settings. Unlike supervised learning, which assumes independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) data, DA explicitly handles covariate and conditional shifts, enabling robust perception, manipulation, and interaction under variability ( HassanPour Zonoozi and Seydi, 2023 ) . In home-care, DA reduces costly data collection and relabelling, improving safety and consistency.
blocks.zh: 随着机器人从实验室设置向家居和RAC设置移动,他们面临着许多挑战. 域适应(DA)解决了这些差距,因此在一个领域(例如模拟或基准数据集)培训的模型在现实世界环境中仍然可靠。 与以独立和相同分布(即d.)的数据为假设的受监督学习不同,DA明确处理共变和有条件的转变,在可变性下促成强感,操纵和相互作用(Hassan Pour Zonoozi和Seydi,2023年). 在家庭护理方面,DA减少了昂贵的数据收集和重新贴标签,提高了安全和一致性。

blocks.en:
Core DA methods learn domain-invariant yet task-relevant representations. Techniques include discrepancy minimisation (e.g., MMD), adversarial alignment (e.g., DANN), and self-training with pseudo-labels, as well as active-learning loops that selectively query caregivers or clinicians for labels on uncertain or safety-critical events.
For example, adversarial DA confuses a domain discriminator to strip domain-specific cues (e.g., furniture textures) while preserving semantics like object categories or grasp points. These approaches support reliable activity recognition and control across diverse homes. Additionally, compared to supervised learning, which degrades under target shift, DA is purpose-built for cross-domain generalisation. SSL and WSL reduce annotation needs but do not guarantee invariance. DA directly targets distribution mismatch, making it well suited for highly variable HRI environments and personalised care contexts ( HassanPour Zonoozi and Seydi, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
核心DA方法学习域-变量但与任务相关的表述. 技术包括差异最小化(例如,微调),对抗性调整(例如,DANN),使用假标签进行自我培训,以及主动学习循环,有选择地向护理人员或临床医生查询不确定或安全关键事件的标签。
例如,对抗性的DA混淆了一个域歧视者来剥离域特定提示(如家具纹理),同时保留对象类或抓点等语义. 这些办法有助于对不同家庭进行可靠的活动确认和控制。 此外,与在目标转变下退化的有监督的学习相比,DA是专为跨域通用而设的。 SSL和WSL减少注释需要,但不能保证无变化. DA直接针对分布不匹配,使其非常适合高度可变性的HRI环境和个性化护理环境(HassanPour Zonoozi和Seydi,2023年).

blocks.en: Recent DA research focuses on embodied AI and home robotics, where sim-to-real transfer and non-stationary targets are common. Simulators such as Habitat and iGibson, along with photorealistic datasets like Matterport3D and Replica, enable large-scale source training, while DA mitigates real-world gaps through feature alignment, style transfer, and test-time adaptation ( Savva et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2021 ) . For manipulation tasks, sim-to-real pipelines incorporate dynamics randomisation and visual perturbations to improve pick-and-place and assistive behaviours despite household variability ( Peng et al., 2018 ) . Adversarial DA methods (e.g., DANN, ADDA) combined with multi-target adaptation help avoid catastrophic interference ( HassanPour Zonoozi and Seydi, 2023 ) , while test-time adaptation ( Wang et al., 2022 ) and batch-normalisation alignment ( Chang et al., 2019 ) enable on-the-fly adjustments to lighting or sensor drift. Discrepancy-based DA (e.g., MMD) and pseudo-label self-training further enhance segmentation of cluttered scenes for safe navigation ( Zou et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近的DA研究侧重于体现的AI和家用机器人,其中的sim-to-real transfer和非固定目标很常见. 模拟器如Hiberty和iGibson,以及Matterport3D和Replica等光现实化数据集可以进行大规模源头培训,而DA则通过特征对齐,风格转移,以及测试时间的适应来缓解现实世界的差距(Savva等人,2019年;Li等人,2021年). 对于操控任务,对现实的管道包含动态随机化和视觉扰动,以改善选址和辅助行为,尽管家庭多变(Peng等人,2018年)。 逆向DA方法(如DANN,ADA)与多目标适应相结合,有助于避免灾难性干扰(HassanPour Zonoozi和Seydi, 2023),而测试时间适应(Wang等人, 2022)和批量正常化调整(Chang等人, 2019)则能够对照明或传感器漂移进行飞行调整. 基于差错的DA(如MMD)和伪标签自我训练,进一步加强了杂乱无章的场景的分割,以进行安全导航(Zou等人,2018年).

blocks.en: Beyond perception, reinforcement learning is increasingly combined with DA for policy-level adaptation and personalisation over time. In home and aged-care deployments, RL policies can adjust reminder timing, navigation strategies, or escalation thresholds based on longitudinal feedback from residents and staff, effectively treating changes in routines, mobility, or furniture layouts as a form of temporal domain shift. Meta-reinforcement learning approaches for social robotics and robotic skill adaptation show how policies can be quickly re-tuned when reward functions or dynamics change across environments. Examples of such an approach include variational meta-RL for social robots ( Finn et al., 2017 ; Zintgraf et al., 2019 ) and variational information-bottleneck regularised deep RL for robotic skills adaptation ( Xiang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 除了认知之外,强化学习越来越多地与DA结合,用于政策层面的适应和个人化。 在家庭护理和老年护理部署方面,RL政策可以根据居民和工作人员纵向反馈调整提醒计时,导航策略,或升级阈值,有效地将常规,流动或家具布局的变化作为时间域转移的一种形式. 用于社会机器人和机器人技能改造的Meta-reinforcement学习方法显示,当奖励功能或动态在环境中发生变化时,政策如何能够快速重新调整. 这种方法的例子包括社会机器人的变异元-RL(Finn等人,2017年;Zintgraf等人,2019年),以及用于机器人技能改造的变异信息-瓶颈规范化深RL(Xiang等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Vision–language models for household tasks (e.g., “find medicine box”) also benefit from DA across viewpoints and linguistic variations, improving instruction following without exhaustive retraining. Combined with few-shot personalisation and active learning during deployment, DA supports rapid adaptation to user routines while maintaining robustness.
blocks.zh: 家庭任务的远景-语言模式(例如 " 发现药盒 " )也受益于不同观点和语言差异的DA, 改进教学,而不进行详尽的再培训。 DA与少发个性化和部署期间的主动学习相结合,支持快速适应用户的常规,同时保持稳健性.

blocks.en:
Despite its advantages, domain adaptation faces several challenges. Negative transfer can occur when source and target distributions differ substantially (e.g., minimal overlap between training homes and a target residence with unique layouts or cultural artifacts). Without reliable measures of transferability, alignment may degrade task performance or induce spurious invariances ( Ng et al., 2024 ) .
Similarly, adversarial alignment can also overemphasise domain indistinguishability at the expense of fine-grained semantics, harming safety-critical tasks such as medication recognition or fall-risk area detection in cluttered rooms ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
尽管具有优势,但域内适应工作面临若干挑战。 当源与目标分布相差很大(例如,训练之家与具有独特布局或文化文物的目标住所之间的最小重叠)时,可以发生负转移. 如果没有可靠的可转移性衡量标准,校正可能会降低任务性能或诱发虚假的偏差(Ng等人,2024年)。
同样,对抗性对接也可能过分强调域的不可分性,而牺牲精细的语义,损害安全的关键任务,如药物识别或在杂乱的房间里发现坠落风险区(Wang等人,2020年;Zhu等人,2024年)。

blocks.en:
Label scarcity and annotation noise remain problematic: pseudo-labels can propagate errors when target conditions are highly variable (moving furniture, seasonal lighting changes, sensor ageing).
Robust self-training, uncertainty estimation, and curriculum-style adaptation are needed to mitigate confirmation bias ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Ko et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
标签稀缺和注释噪声仍成问题:在目标条件变化很大(移动家具、季节性照明变化、传感器老化)时,伪标签会传播错误。
为减少确认偏差,需要强有力的自我培训、不确定性估计和课程式调整(Huang等人,2024年;Ko等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: For long-term deployment, RL-based DA introduces additional difficulties: reward signals may be sparse or delayed, user preferences and mobility can drift over months, and safe exploration is heavily constrained in care settings. Practical personalisation therefore relies on conservative update rules, explicit human-in-the-loop feedback, and continual-learning schemes that view temporal drift as a sequence of related domains rather than a single stationary environment ( Garcıa and Fernández, 2015 ; Liu et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 就长期部署而言,基于RL的DA带来了更多的困难:奖励信号可能稀少或延迟,用户偏好和移动能力可能会在几个月内漂移,在护理环境中安全探索受到严重限制. 因此,实际的个性化依赖于保守的更新规则、明确的即时人反馈,以及将时间漂移视为相关领域序列而非单一固定环境的不断学习计划(García和Fernández,2015年;Liu等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: Finally, in RAC and private homes, these methods must also operate under strict privacy and consent constraints, further limiting the volume and granularity of target data available for adaptation and reinforcing the need for conservative, well-audited DA strategies.
blocks.zh: 最后,在RAC和私人住宅中,这些方法还必须在严格的隐私和同意限制下运作,进一步限制可用于适应的目标数据的数量和颗粒性,并更加需要保守的、经过充分审计的DA战略。

blocks.en: 5 Privacy, trust and acceptability
blocks.zh: 5 隐私、信任和可接受性

blocks.en:
Privacy, trust, and acceptability are foundational requirements for deploying robots and ambient intelligence in private and RAC homes.
These systems operate in intimate spaces, observing sensitive routines and often supporting people with reduced capacity to monitor or control technology, so they must protect dignity, choice, and control, not just deliver useful support.
As a result, privacy expectations are not abstract ethical ideals but concrete design constraints that shape sensing, data flows, and interaction patterns. Trust shapes whether residents, families, and staff feel confident in the system, combining cognitive factors (e.g., reliability) and affective factors (e.g., perceived intentions and emotional connection) ( Rossi et al., 2021 ) . Acceptability refers to whether users perceive the system as suitable and useful in their context, balancing functional utility and emotional comfort ( Felding et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) .
These concepts are tightly linked: ambiguous privacy erodes trust, and low trust can lead to rejection even when systems are technically capable.
blocks.zh:
隐私、信任和可接受性是将机器人和环境情报部署到私人和RAC之家的基本要求。
这些系统在亲密空间运作,观察敏感的例行程序,并经常支持那些监测或控制技术能力减弱的人,因此它们必须保护尊严、选择和控制,而不仅仅是提供有用的支持。
因此,隐私期望不是抽象的道德理想,而是塑造感知,数据流动和相互作用模式的具体设计限制. 信任会塑造居民,家庭和员工是否对系统有信心,结合认知因素(如可靠性)和情感因素(如感知意图和情感联系)(Rossi等人,2021年). 可接受性是指用户是否认为该系统在上下文中是合适和有用的,是否平衡了功能效用和情感舒适性(Felding等人,2023年;Zhao等人,2025年)。
这些概念紧密相连:模糊的隐私侵蚀了信任,即使系统具备技术能力,低信任也会导致拒绝.

blocks.en:
Building on the constraints outlined in Section 2 and the sensing and learning choices in Section 4 , this section examines how these capabilities translate into practical safeguards, drawing on older adults’ perspectives on privacy and governance ( Slane and Pedersen, 2025 ) and ethics-of-care frameworks that emphasise relational dynamics and vulnerability in aged care settings ( Yuan et al., 2023 ) .
Together, these perspectives define a practical goal for this chapter: to advocate for systems that are useful, respectful, and explainable in the environments where people live.
blocks.zh:
以第2节概述的制约因素以及第4节的感知和学习选择为基础,本节审查这些能力如何转化为实际保障,借鉴了老年人对隐私和治理的看法(Slane和Pedersen,2025年)以及强调老年人护理环境中关系动态和脆弱性的护理道德框架(袁等人,2023年)。
这些观点共同确定了本章的一个实际目标:倡导在人们生活的环境中有用、尊重和可解释的系统。

blocks.en: 1 Privacy
blocks.zh: 1 隐私

blocks.en: Conceptual overview
blocks.zh: 概念概述

blocks.en:
Privacy in socially-assistive robots and smart home systems has three dimensions.
First, informational privacy , or control over personal data such as faces, voices, and routines.
Second, contextual privacy which requires respecting social norms in sensitive spaces like bedrooms, bathrooms, or shared lounges.
Third, decisional privacy , the right to refuse, pause, or mute a device. For older adults, these concerns surface in clear questions: What does the robot record? Who will see it? How can I stop it ( Slane and Pedersen, 2025 ) ?
blocks.zh:
社会辅助机器人和智能家庭系统的隐私有三个层面.
第一,信息隐私,或控制个人数据,如面部、声音和日常。
第二,在卧室、浴室或共用休息室等敏感空间,需要尊重社会规范的背景隐私。
第三,决定性隐私,拒绝、暂停或关闭设备的权利。 对于老年人来说,这些关切出现在明确的问题中: 机器人录了什么? 谁会看到它? 我怎么能阻止它(斯兰和佩德森,2025年)?

blocks.en: Challenges
blocks.zh: 挑战

blocks.en: Common risks in home care settings include always-on microphones, video recording, and silent background uploads. Consent is rarely a one-time event; cognitive changes, rotating staff, and visiting family complicate ongoing agreement. Some people feel safer with monitoring and accept intrusion, while others reject sensing even when it could help. This is the privacy paradox. Designs should respect both choices by making settings visible and reversible ( Yuan et al., 2023 ) . In practice, this means avoiding hidden sensing, setting conservative defaults, and allowing simple ways to pause or narrow sensing scope, all aligned with the interaction hooks described in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 家庭护理环境中的常见风险包括:总是戴着麦克风,录影带,以及无声背景上传. 同意很少是一次性事件;认知变化、工作人员轮换和来访家庭使正在进行的协议复杂化。 有些人对监控和接受入侵感到更安全,而另一些人则拒绝感知,即使感知可以有所帮助。 这就是隐私悖论。 设计应尊重两种选择,使设置可见和可逆(袁等人,2023年)。 在实践中,这意味着避免隐藏感知,设置保守的默认,并允许简单的暂停或狭义感知范围的方法,这些方法都与第3节描述的相互作用钩吻合.

blocks.en: User perspectives
blocks.zh: 用户视角

blocks.en:
Studies with older adults report a consistent trade-off: people value safety through fall detection or check-in calls, but resist constant recording.
Comfort improves when systems provide visible states, such as a light that shows when audio is live, short default retention periods, and clear explanations.
People also value ways to review what was captured and to delete it ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Slane and Pedersen, 2025 ) . These expectations are similar in both RAC and private homes, though shared settings raise additional governance questions: who decides the rules, and how will disagreements be resolved?
blocks.zh:
与老年人的研究表明,双方始终取舍:人们通过秋季检测或登机检查重视安全,但抵制不断记录。
当系统提供可见状态时,舒适性会改善,例如显示音频直播时的光线,短的默认保留期,以及清晰的解释.
人们也重视审查所捕捉到的东西并删除之方法(赵等人,2025年;斯兰和佩德森,2025年)。 这些期望在RAC和私人住宅中都是相似的,尽管共享环境提出了额外的治理问题:规则由谁决定,分歧如何解决?

blocks.en: Policy and legal frameworks
blocks.zh: 政策和法律框架

blocks.en:
Teams should align with regional rules without reducing design to a compliance exercise. In the European Union, the AI Act sets risk-based obligations for systems that influence health and safety, including requirements for risk management, data governance, transparency, and human oversight ( European Parliament and the Council of the European Union, 2024 ) . ISO and IEC provide complementary guidance on managing risk in artificial intelligence systems ( International Organization for Standardization and International Electrotechnical Commission, 2023 ) .
In Australia, the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner explains duties for collection, consent, access, and security for personal information, including audio and video ( Office of the Australian Information Commissioner, 2022 ) . Accessibility guidance such as WCAG 2.2 ensures controls remain visible and usable for people with low vision or hearing loss ( World Wide Web Consortium (W3C), 2023 ) . These frameworks establish baselines for consent, logging, and access that technical and clinical teams can share.
blocks.zh:
团队应与区域规则保持一致,而不应将设计缩减为合规工作。 在欧洲联盟,《AI法》为影响健康和安全的系统规定了基于风险的义务,包括对风险管理、数据治理、透明度和人的监督的要求(欧洲议会和欧洲联盟理事会,2024年)。 ISO和国际电工委员会就人工智能系统风险管理提供补充指导(国际标准化组织和国际电工委员会,2023年)。
在澳大利亚,澳大利亚信息专员办公室解释了收集、同意、获取和保障个人信息的义务,包括音频和视频(澳大利亚信息专员办公室,2022年)。 无障碍指导,如WCAG 2.2,确保控制保持可见性,对视力低或听力低的人有用(万维网联合会,2023年)。 这些框架为同意、伐木以及技术和临床小组可以共享的获取权确定了基线。

blocks.en: Privacy-by-design
blocks.zh: 逐一设计隐私

blocks.en:
Privacy by design translates principles into concrete safeguards. Key practices include minimising data collection, preferring on-device inference, storing summaries instead of raw audio or video, applying face and voice blurring for data leaving the device, limiting retention with visible settings, and providing role-based access so carers see only what they need.
A simple pipeline illustrates this: sense only what is needed, process data locally where possible, convert signals into filtered events (e.g., suspected falls or missed medication prompts), share events only with consented parties, and delete underlying data on a clear schedule.
Privacy-preserving learning methods, such as federated learning and related approaches, can improve models without pooling raw personal data ( Casado, 2024 ) . Transparency should be embedded, with live indicators when sensing is active and an easy one-touch pause ( Marchang et al., 2023 ) . These ideas align with interaction hooks in Section 3 , and uphold the principle that people should always be able to see and control what the system is doing.
blocks.zh:
设计上的隐私将原则转化为具体的保障措施。 关键做法包括尽量减少数据收集、偏好视线推论、储存摘要而不是原始音频或视频、对离开设备的数据应用面部和语音模糊、限制保留可见的设置以及提供基于角色的存取,从而使照料者只看到他们需要的东西。
一个简单的管道可以说明这一点:只了解需要什么,尽可能在当地处理数据,将信号转换成过滤事件(例如,疑似坠落或错过的药物提示),只与同意方分享事件,在明确的时间表上删除基本数据。
保持隐私的学习方法,如联合学习和相关方法,可以在不汇集原始个人数据的情况下改进模型(Casado,2024年). 透明度应嵌入其中,在感知活动时有实况指示器,并易于一触即发(Marchang等人,2023年)。 这些想法与第3节中的交互钩一致,并坚持人们应该永远能够看到和控制系统正在做的事情的原则。

blocks.en: Threat models for home robots and ambient sensors highlight risks such as unauthorised access, inference attacks, and silent data leakage ( Hung et al., 2022a ; Zieni et al., 2025 ) . These risks should be mitigated through conservative defaults, secure update mechanisms, and clear incident reporting paths that facility operators can follow when something goes wrong.
blocks.zh: 家用机器人和环境感应器的威胁模型凸显出未经授权进入、推论攻击和无声数据泄漏等风险(Hung等人,2022a); Zieni等人,2025年). 这些风险应该通过保守的默认,安全更新机制,以及设施运营商在出错时可以遵循的明确的事件报告路径来缓解.

blocks.en: 2 Trust
blocks.zh: 2个信托基金

blocks.en: Definition and dimensions
blocks.zh: 定义和层面

blocks.en: Trust in human-robot interaction has two key dimensions: performance-based trust reflects confidence that the system works reliably, while relational trust reflects confidence that the system respects the person and will not deceive or harm them. In both private and RAC homes, these dimensions are inseparable: a robot that is accurate but opaque will not be welcome, and a robot that is friendly but unreliable will be ignored.
blocks.zh: 对人类-机器人互动的信任有两个关键层面:基于性能的信任反映了对系统可靠运作的信心,而关系信任则反映了对系统尊重人并且不会欺骗或伤害人的信心. 在私人和RAC家庭,这些维度是不可分割的:一个准确但不透明的机器人不会受到欢迎,一个友好但不可靠的机器人会被忽略.

blocks.en: Design considerations
blocks.zh: 设计方面的考虑

blocks.en: Ethical frameworks such as care-centred and value-sensitive design offer practical guidance for trustworthy HRI, emphasising transparency, autonomy, and emotional safety. Systems should clearly communicate what they sense and how decisions are made, while offering control and reversibility. When confidence is low, such as during fall detection or ambiguous commands, the system should defer to a human rather than act autonomously, as also reflected in recent reviews ( Yuan et al., 2023 ; Rossi et al., 2021 ) . Designers should avoid overstating capabilities and instead calibrate expectations through simple feedback, for example, by showing what the robot saw and why it responded. These principles align with fallback and recovery strategies discussed in Section 3 and support relational trust, where users feel respected and safe.
blocks.zh: 以照料为中心、注重价值的设计等道德框架为可靠的人权提供了实际指导,强调透明度、自主性和情感安全。 系统应明确传达其感受和如何作出决定,同时提供控制和可逆转性。 当信心低落时,例如在秋季探测或命令模糊时,系统应服从于人而不是自主行动,这在最近的评论中也有所反映(袁等人,2023年;罗西等人,2021年). 设计者应避免夸大其词的能力,而是通过简单的反馈来校准期望,例如通过显示机器人所看到的以及它为什么响应. 这些原则与第3节讨论的后退和恢复战略相一致,并支持用户感到受到尊重和安全的关系信任。

blocks.en: Interaction factors
blocks.zh: 相互作用因素

blocks.en: Three design choices shape trust in daily use. First, ensure operation transparent: indicate when microphones or cameras are active, and announce state changes with both light and speech so people with low vision or hearing can follow. Second, prioritise reliability and graceful recovery: apply the recovery ladder from Section 3 with a Plan B that falls back to a large-screen prompt and a Plan R that retries before offering handover to a human contact. Third, aim for emotional fit: avoid human-like imitation that feels deceptive or stigmatising; instead, use a consistent voice, gentle motion, and simple expressive lighting that users can understand ( Rossi et al., 2021 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Trust is built gradually through honest behaviour, clear explanation of faults, and visible learning from incidents.
blocks.zh: 三种设计选择塑造了对日常使用的信任. 首先,确保操作透明:指示麦克风或摄像头活动的时间,并宣布有光线和语音的状态变化,这样视力或听力低的人就可以跟随. 第二,优先重视可靠性和优雅的恢复:采用从第3节起的恢复阶梯,采用B计划,返回到大屏幕的提示器和R计划,在向人类接触者移交之前进行重复。 第三,情感适合的目标:避免让人感觉欺骗或污名化的类似人类的模仿;相反,使用一致的声音,温柔的动作,以及用户能够理解的简单的表达照明(Rossi等人,2021年;Zhao等人,2025年). 信任通过诚实行为,明确解释过错,对事件的明显学习逐步建立起来.

blocks.en: Stakeholder collaboration
blocks.zh: 利益攸关方合作

blocks.en: Trust must be established with all stakeholders. Residents and families need clear consent and control. Care workers need actionable alerts and simple tools to adjust routines. Facility operators need logs and reports. Designers and vendors need ways to learn from field data without exposing personal information. Effective projects use short co-design cycles with staff and residents, then expand once routines are stable ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) . Longitudinal studies show that trust evolves over time and must be maintained through consistent behaviour and transparent updates ( Van Maris et al., 2020 ; Campagna and Rehm, 2025 ) , motivating the longitudinal evaluation measures discussed in Section 6 .
blocks.zh: 必须与所有利益攸关方建立信任。 居民和家庭需要明确的同意和控制。 护理工作者需要可操作的警报和简单的工具来调整日常工作. 设施运营商需要日志和报告. 设计师和销售商需要在不暴露个人信息的情况下学习实地数据。 有效的项目使用与员工和居民的短期共同设计周期,然后在常规稳定后扩大(Zhao等人,2023年). 纵向研究表明,信任会随着时间演变,必须通过一致的行为和透明的最新情况加以维持(Van Maris等人,2020年;Campagna和Rehm,2025年),从而推动第6节所讨论的纵向评价措施。

blocks.en: 3 Acceptability
blocks.zh: 3 可接受性

blocks.en: Frameworks
blocks.zh: 框架

blocks.en: Acceptability in RAC and private homes is commonly assessed with two families of models. The Theoretical Framework of Acceptability (TFA) comprises seven constructs—affective attitude, burden, perceived effectiveness, ethicality, intervention coherence, opportunity cost, and self-efficacy—and has been recently applied to social robots supporting community-dwelling older adults ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . The Almere Model, adapted from the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT), extends these ideas with social-interaction factors such as trust, social presence, and perceived sociability, as demonstrated in nursing-home deployments ( Felding et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 通常由两个模范家庭评估可接受性。 接受性理论框架包括7个构件——情感态度、负担、感知效力、道德、干预一致性、机会成本和自我效能,最近还应用于支持社区居住的老年人的社会机器人(赵等人,2025年)。 从技术接受模式(TAM)和技术接受与使用统一理论(UTAUT)中改编的Almere模型将这些想法延伸至社会互动因素,如信任、社会存在和感知的社交性(Felding等人,2023年)。

blocks.en:
Qualitative extensions further highlight reliability, anxiety, and relational aspects in caregiver–user contexts ( Felber et al., 2024 ) .
Across these traditions, acceptance constructs converge around four recurrent domains:
(1) perceived effectiveness,
(2)burden and usability,
(3) ethical and relational fit, and
(4) affective engagement, which together provide a unifying lens for evaluating social robots in care.
These relationships are summarised conceptually in Fig. 8 , which illustrates the four recurrent domains and their theoretical roots in the TFA, Almere, and TAM/UTAUT model families.
blocks.zh:
定性扩展进一步突出了照料者-用户背景下的可靠性、焦虑和关系方面(Felber等人,2024年)。
在这些传统中,接受结构围绕着四个反复出现的领域:
(1) 认为有效,
(2) 负担和可用性,
(3) 符合道德和关系,以及
(4) 情感接触,共同为评估在护理中的社会机器人提供统一视角。
图8概述了这些关系,说明了四个反复出现的领域及其在TFA、Almere和TAM/UTAUT模式家庭的理论根源。

blocks.zh:

blocks.en: User studies
blocks.zh: 用户研究

blocks.en: Community trials show that acceptance improves when benefits are immediate and visible. For example, features such as easier family contact, routine reminders, and fall alerts that work without constant recording. Acceptance improves when the system is proactive but bounded, and when users can opt out at any time ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Reviews also stress clear design rules for contact and navigation in tight spaces ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) . Negative experiences often relate less to raw accuracy and more to frustration, interruption, or feelings of being monitored, which underscores the importance of the privacy and trust controls above.
blocks.zh: 社区试验表明,当利益立即显现时,接受程度会提高。 例如,方便家庭接触、例行提醒和不不断录音的秋季警报等功能。 当系统主动但有限度时,以及当用户可以随时选择退出时(Zhao et al., 2025),接受情况就会得到改善。 评论还强调了在紧凑空间中接触和导航的明确设计规则(赵等人,2023年). 负面经验往往较少涉及原始的准确性,更多涉及挫折感、中断感或被监测的感觉,这突出了上述隐私和信任控制的重要性。

blocks.en: Influencing factors
blocks.zh: 影响因素

blocks.en:
Acceptance is shaped by culture, language, and prior experience. Stigma is a real risk if a device looks like a medical alarm. Simple and friendly shapes fare better than humanoid imitations. Multilingual prompts and easy name customisation help in diverse homes.
Training for staff and family is critical: acceptance grows when carers can adjust schedules and content without technical help ( Jones et al., 2025 ) . Designers should therefore plan for configuration tools that fit care workflows, rather than assuming a technician will always be available.
blocks.zh:
接受取决于文化、语言和以往的经验。 如果一个装置看起来像医疗警报器,羞辱是一种真正的风险. 简单而友好的形状比人造仿制品的票价更好. 多种语言的提示和方便的名字自定义有助于不同家庭。
对工作人员和家庭的培训至关重要:如果照料者能够在没有技术帮助的情况下调整时间表和内容,接受率就会增加(Jones等人,2025年)。 因此,设计者应规划适合护理工作流程的配置工具,而不是假定总有技术员。

blocks.en: Long-term engagement
blocks.zh: 长期参与

blocks.en: Many projects experience a novelty effect in the first weeks, followed by a decline. Sustained use requires measuring daily participation over months and refreshing content regularly. Some people report discomfort when robots try to mimic humans too closely. This uncanny valley effect can be reduced with honest design that avoids human imitation and by setting clear boundaries on system capabilities ( Rossi et al., 2021 ) . Ultimately, robots should be treated as part of a care program led by people, not as replacements.
blocks.zh: 许多项目在最初的几周里都经历了一种新颖的效果,之后又出现了下降. 持续使用需要衡量几个月的日常参与情况,并定期更新内容。 有些人报告说,当机器人试图模仿人类时,感到不适。 这种不可思议的山谷效应可以通过诚实的设计来降低,避免人类模仿,并通过对系统能力设定明确的界限(Rossi等人,2021年). 归根结底,机器人应该被当作由人领导的护理计划的一部分,而不是被替换.

blocks.en: Co-design methods
blocks.zh: 共同设计方法

blocks.en: Participatory design approaches involving older adults and caregivers are essential for tailoring systems to real needs and improving long-term acceptability. Co-design helps uncover subtle preferences, cultural norms, and usability barriers that standard testing may miss. Studies show that early user involvement leads to more trusted and usable systems ( Sumner et al., 2021 ; Backåberg et al., 2025 ) . These methods also support emotional engagement and ownership, which are key to sustained use in domestic and care settings. Co-design activities can also uncover privacy and trust expectations early, avoiding costly redesign when deployments reach the field.
blocks.zh: 涉及老年人和照顾者的参与性设计办法对于使系统适应实际需要和提高长期可接受性至关重要。 共同设计有助于发现标准测试可能错过的微妙偏好、文化规范和可用性障碍。 研究表明,早期的用户参与导致更可信和有用的系统(Sumner等人,2021年;Backåberg等人,2025年)。 这些方法还支持情感参与和主人翁精神,这是在家庭和照料环境中持续使用的关键。 共同设计活动还可以及早发现隐私和信任期望,避免在部署到达外地时进行费用高昂的重新设计。

blocks.en: 4 Intersections and trade-offs
blocks.zh: 4 交叉和权衡

blocks.en: Privacy, trust, and acceptability are independent but interconnected. Strong privacy defaults can reduce data for learning, which may lower performance, while aggressive automation may boost short-term efficiency but erode trust if people feel excluded from decisions. The balance depends on context: in a private home, a person may choose stronger privacy and accept fewer features; in an RAC, shared rules may be needed for fairness and consistency across residents.
blocks.zh: 隐私、信任和可接受性是独立的,但相互关联。 强烈的隐私默认可以减少学习数据,这可能会降低性能,而积极的自动化可能会提高短期效率,但如果人们感到被排除在决策之外,则会削弱信任. 平衡取决于背景:在私人住宅中,一个人可以选择更强的隐私,接受更少的特征;在RAC中,可能需要共同的规则,以便居民之间公平和一致.

blocks.en: These balances also differ across stakeholder groups. Older adults often prioritise agency, independence, and dignity even when this entails some residual risk; whereas clinicians and care staff emphasise safety, reliability, and efficiency within constrained workflows. Families may value reassurance and frequent updates, sometimes favouring more intensive monitoring than the resident themselves would prefer. Field studies in care homes repeatedly report such tensions between resident-centred and staff-centred goals, and show how they shape the configuration and day-to-day use of robots and ambient systems ( De Graaf et al., 2019 ; Sharkey and Sharkey, 2012 ; Yeo et al., 2023 ; Carros et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 这些平衡也因利益攸关方群体而异。 老年人往往把机构、独立性和尊严放在优先地位,即使这带来一些残余风险;而临床医生和护理人员则强调在有限的工作流程中的安全、可靠性和效率。 家庭可能重视保证和经常更新,有时比居民自己更倾向于加强监测。 护理之家的实地研究一再报告以居民为中心的目标与以工作人员为中心的目标之间的紧张关系,并表明它们如何塑造机器人和环境系统的配置和日常使用(De Graaf等人,2019年;Sharkey和Sharkey,2012年;Yeo等人,2023年;Carros等人,2022年)。

blocks.en:
A practical path emerges from earlier sections: make sensing and state visible, keep data local, offer simple explanations and controls, and evaluate beyond accuracy by considering burden, recovery, and long-term acceptance ( Slane and Pedersen, 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2023 ; Rossi et al., 2021 ) .
In practice, handling conflicting functional and ethical requirements means making these trade-offs explicit and negotiated rather than implicit. Co-design and governance processes should surface where resident agency, staff workload, clinical risk, and family reassurance pull in different directions; and the use of a simple task, risk, and burden lens to justify which compromises are adopted in a given deployment should be considered ( Sumner et al., 2021 ) .
Privacy trade-offs become concrete when teams decide what to log, how long to keep logged data, and which errors they are willing to tolerate, which is why Section 6 treats evaluation as part of governance rather than a separate technical step.
blocks.zh:
从前面的章节中出现了一条实用的道路:使感知和状态可见,使数据保持局部,提供简单的解释和控制,并通过考虑负担,恢复,以及长期接受来评价超出准确度(Slane and Pedersen,2025;Yuan等人,2023;Rossi等人,2021).
在实践中,处理相互矛盾的职能和道德要求,意味着使这些取舍明确化,并经过谈判,而不是暗示。 共同设计和治理过程应显示驻地机构、工作人员工作量、临床风险和家庭保障在不同方向;应考虑使用简单的任务、风险和负担透镜来说明在特定部署中采用何种妥协(Sumner等人,2021年)。
隐私权衡在小组决定记录什么、保存记录数据的时间和他们愿意容忍哪些错误时变得具体,这就是为什么第6节将评价视为治理的一部分而不是单独的技术步骤。

blocks.en: 5 Risk management and governance
blocks.zh: 5 风险管理和治理

blocks.en: Risk management for RAC and private homes should connect design choices to governance duties and daily practice. It begins by defining the intended use and context, and then identifying the main classes of risk, such as physical safety, data protection, and psychosocial or dignity impacts. Controls should be simple and auditable: local inference where possible, short retention with clear settings, visible states for listening and recording, and conservative motion near people. Plans must include recovery from common faults (e.g., low battery, network loss, or obstructed sensors) and specify how human oversight intervenes when confidence is low. During deployment, teams monitor and report a small set of field metrics that matter to residents and staff, including near misses, false alarms per day, docking success, and time to recover after faults. These should be reviewed with caregivers at regular intervals. A brief, regularly updated risk register helps track ownership and changes. This approach aligns with the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act and with ISO or IEC guidance on risk management for artificial intelligence, and helps prepare evidence for privacy and accessibility expectations in local regulations and standards ( European Parliament and the Council of the European Union, 2024 ; International Organization for Standardization and International Electrotechnical Commission, 2023 ; Office of the Australian Information Commissioner, 2022 ; World Wide Web Consortium (W3C), 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 相关活动代码和私人住宅的风险管理应当将设计选择与治理职责和日常做法联系起来。 它首先界定预定用途和背景,然后确定主要的风险类别,如人身安全、数据保护以及社会心理或尊严影响。 控制应该是简单和可审计的:尽可能进行局部推论,保留时间短,设置清晰,可以显示监听和录音状态,以及接近人的保守运动。 计划必须包括从常见故障(例如电池电池低、网络丢失或传感器受阻)中回收,并具体说明在信心低的情况下,人的监督如何进行干预。 在部署期间,各小组监测并向居民和工作人员报告一套对外地情况很重要的衡量标准,包括近失失、每天的假警报、对接成功以及故障后恢复的时间。 应定期与照料者一起审查这些问题。 定期更新的简短风险登记册有助于跟踪所有权和变化。 这种做法符合《欧洲联盟人工智能法》和ISO或IEC关于人工智能风险管理的指导意见,并有助于为地方条例和标准中的隐私和无障碍预期准备证据(欧洲议会和欧洲联盟理事会,2024年;国际标准化组织和国际电工委员会,2023年;澳大利亚信息专员办公室,2022年;万维网联合会,2023年)。

blocks.en: 6 Benchmarking and evaluation
blocks.zh: 6 基准制定和评价

blocks.en: RAC homes and private homes are dynamic, cluttered, and resource-constrained environments. Systems that are designed and evaluated only in labs often fail to capture what matters in daily use, including alarm fatigue, recovery after faults, caregiver workload, and dignity or privacy trade-offs. Benchmarking must therefore move beyond accuracy to include operational, ethical, and usability dimensions that reflect real-world conditions.
blocks.zh: RAC住宅和私人住宅是动态的,杂乱无章,资源紧张的环境. 只在实验室设计和评价的系统往往无法掌握日常使用中的重要内容,包括警报疲劳、断层后恢复、照料者工作量以及尊严或隐私权衡。 因此,基准必须超越准确性,纳入反映现实世界条件的业务、道德和可用性层面。

blocks.en:
This section proposes a staged evaluation framework that connects interaction choices (Section 3 ) and privacy controls (Section 5 ) with measurable outcomes so that pilot studies can be compared over time and across sites.
It is organised around four progressively complex deployment scenarios, plus a consolidated view of performance and reporting metrics: simulations and offline evaluations, lab-based trials, pilot studies, and long-term deployments.
Fig. 9 provides a simple illustration of these stages, and clarifies which families of measures become most informative as systems progress toward sustained autonomy.
Across all stages, standard machine learning metrics such as accuracy, sensitivity, or area under the curve remain necessary but insufficient in aged care HRI. To support consistent comparison across sites, teams should carry a core set of operational measures through the full ladder, including safety events and near misses, false alarm burden per resident per day, caregiver workload change, time to recover after failures, privacy friction such as mute, pause, or opt out actions, and acceptability traces such as minutes of use per day and participation rate over weeks. For social and companion robots, additional indicators include reports on acceptability, usability, discomfort or rejection (e.g., uncanny valley effects), and how changes in appearance, voice, or behaviour impact engagement ( Damiano and Dumouchel, 2018 ) .
blocks.zh:
本节提议建立一个分阶段评价框架,将互动选择(第3节)和隐私控制(第5节)与可衡量的成果联系起来,以便随着时间的推移和不同地点对试点研究进行比较。
它围绕四个逐渐复杂的部署设想方案,加上业绩和报告衡量标准的综合看法:模拟和离线评价、实验室试验、试点研究和长期部署。
图9简单说明了这些阶段的情况,并说明了随着系统向持续自治迈进,哪些措施家庭的信息最为丰富。
在所有阶段,精确度、敏感性或曲线下领域等标准机器学习指标仍然必要,但在老年护理人权中还不够。 为了支持在各地点之间进行一致的比较,各小组应通过整个阶梯执行一套核心行动措施,包括安全事件和近失事、每个居民每天虚假的警报负担、照料者工作量的变化、故障后恢复的时间、诸如哑声、暂停或选择退出行动的隐私摩擦、以及可接受痕迹,例如每天使用记录和参与率超过几周。 对于社交和伴奏机器人,其他指标包括:关于可接受性,可用性,不适或拒绝的报告(如:uncanny Valley effect),以及外观,语音或行为影响接触的变化情况(Damiano and Dumouchel, 2018).

blocks.en: Figure 9 : A staged evaluation timeline for assistive and social robots and ambient AI in private and care homes. The emphasis shifts from dataset and simulator metrics to safety, workflow, privacy, and long-term reliability measures as systems progress toward sustained deployment.
blocks.zh: 图9:对私人和护理家庭的辅助和社会机器人及环境AI的分阶段评估时间表。 随着系统向持续部署迈进,重点从数据集和模拟度量衡转向安全、工作流程、隐私和长期可靠性度量。

blocks.en: 1 Simulations and offline evaluations
blocks.zh: 1 模拟和离线评价

blocks.en:
Simulation and dataset-driven evaluation provide a low-risk way to test feasibility and bound failure modes before any exposure to residents or staff. At this stage, teams can stress-test perception and planning under clutter, occlusion, and lighting variation, and establish baseline compute and power profiles that will later constrain on-device deployment.
These ideas are often implemented in simulation testbeds that combine 3D care-home environments, mapping views, and offline evaluation dashboards for replay and analysis, as illustrated in Fig. 10 .

模拟和数据集驱动的评价为在任何居民或工作人员接触之前测试可行性和约束性故障模式提供了一种低风险方式。 在这一阶段,各小组可以在杂乱无章、隐蔽和照明变异下,对感知和规划进行压力测试,并建立基线计算和动力剖面,以便日后限制装置的部署。

Results here should be treated as necessary evidence for progression to lab trials, not as proof of real-world reliability.
Development and evaluation in an offline setting using simulation platforms or pre-collected datasets is a key first step for any new technology. Within the home care domain, a number of datasets and tools exist to support this stage. Key resources include:

利用模拟平台或预先收集的数据集进行离线开发和评价是任何新技术的关键第一步。 在家庭护理领域,有一些数据集和工具支持这一阶段。 主要资源包括:

blocks.en:
• Ambient and smart-home datasets .
The CASAS program provides large, longitudinal ambient datasets from real homes (motion, door, environmental sensors with some activity labels). Newer releases extend through 2024 and are useful for routine and change-point modelling, but have limited video or audio data for privacy reasons ( Cook et al., 2012 ; Cook, 2025 ) . These datasets are helpful for testing routine detection, anomaly detection, and basic workload estimates before moving to in-person trials. • Falls and activity recognition datasets (vision) .
Recent reviews catalogue vision-based fall datasets and methods; these reveal small sample sizes, staged data, and limited demographics. While datasets are useful for model pruning or ablation, they offer no proof of reliability. When using such data, one should expect domain shift in real deployments and plan for small, local validation sets with older adults ( Benkaci et al., 2024 ; Inturi et al., 2025 ) . • Embodied and simulation test beds .
For navigation and manipulation in houses, Habitat (fast photorealistic rendering) ( Savva et al., 2019 ) , AI2-THOR (interactive kitchen/living scenes) ( Kolve et al., 2017 ) , iGibson and OmniGibson (interactive, physics-rich home scenes) ( Li et al., 2021 ) , and BEHAVIOR-1K (everyday household activities with evaluation protocols) ( Li et al., 2023 ) provide rich test beds. These tools are useful for stress tests and ablations before field trials, for example, checking how quickly a robot recovers from localisation loss or how navigation time changes with clutter. However, teams should still plan for the reality gap and validate behaviours with small staged pilots in real-world settings.

• 环境与智能家庭数据集。
CASAS程序提供来自真实家居(运动,门,环境传感器带有一些活动标签)的大型纵向环境数据集. 较新的版本延伸至2024年,对常规和变点建模有用,但因隐私原因视频或音频数据有限(Cook等人,2012年;Cook,2025年). 这些数据集有助于在进行亲身试验之前测试例行检测、异常检测和基本工作量估计。 • 瀑布和活动识别数据集(视觉)
最近的审查将基于愿景的秋季数据集和方法编目;这些数据集和方法显示样本规模小,数据阶段化,人口统计有限。 虽然数据集对模型的检查或衰竭很有用,但它们没有提供可靠性的证据。 在使用此类数据时,人们应当预期,实际部署和规划与老年人有关的小型、局部验证套件(Benkaci等人,2024年;Inturi等人,2025年)。
关于房屋导航和操纵,生境(快速光现实化渲染)(Savva等人,2019年),AI2-THOR(互动厨房/生活场景) (Kolve等人,2017年),iGibson和OmniGibson(互动,物理丰富家居场景)(Li等人,2021年),和BEHAVIOR-1K(每天的家庭活动都有评价协议)(Li等人,2023年)提供丰富的测试床位. 这些工具对于实地试验前的应激测试和冲洗很有用,例如,检查机器人从本地化损失中恢复的速度,或者导航时间与杂乱无章的变化. 然而,各小组仍应规划现实差距,并验证在现实世界环境中小规模试点的行为。

blocks.en: Gaps remain: Privacy-labelled HRI datasets with per-frame tags are rare. These gaps motivate careful local data collection under the privacy safeguards discussed in Section 5 .
